What are Discord Orbs? 

Info: The Discord Orbs Beta is currently available to select users on desktop and browser. By using Discord Orbs, you agree to the Discord Orbs Terms contained in our Paid Services Terms.

Discord Orbs are rewards you earn by completing Quests. You can use them in the Shop to get Nitro credits, items from the main collections, and more. It’s an easy way to unlock Discord upgrades, no payment method required.

How do I earn Discord Orbs?

1. To start earning Orbs, accept a Quest that offers them as a reward. You can do this in several ways on the desktop app and browser client:

  • Through the Quest Bar
    • You will occasionally see the Quest bar pop up in the bottom-left of the app when you're eligible for a Quest. Hover over it to learn more and get started!

Quest Bar in Discord Desktop App

  • Through Quest Home (Discover > Quests)

Navigating to Quest Home through Discover Tab

2. Complete the Quest and claim your Orbs reward. 

Example of Claiming Discord Orbs from a Quest

3. You can check your Orbs balance in the top-right corner of Quest Home and Shop. 

Spending Your Discord Orbs

Where can I spend Orbs?

Head to the Shop tab to begin spending your Discord Orbs!

Desktop/Browser

1. Navigate to your Direct Messages list by selecting the Discord app icon in the upper-left corner. 

2. Then, press the Shop tab [] to the right of your server list to enter the Shop.

3. In the Shop, select the Orbs Exclusives tab at the top to view Orbs-exclusive items.

Navigating to the Shop

What can I buy with Orbs? 

Here’s what you can purchase with Orbs in the Shop: 

  • Shop items from the main collections
  • Orbs-exclusives: Nitro Credits, a profile badge, special Avatar Decoration, and special Profile Effect. 

You cannot purchase these items with Orbs: 

  • Partner-branded Shop items
  • Gifts
  • Recurring Nitro or Boosting subscriptions
Note: Nitro credits are considered an Orbs-exclusive item within the Shop. However, you can also earn them occasionally by completing specific Quests.

How to Spend Orbs

  1. Browse Orbs-exclusive items in the Orbs Exclusives tab of the Shop, or check the Shop All tab to see the full collection of items that can be claimed with Orbs. If you don’t see an Orbs price on an item, it means it’s not eligible to be claimed with Orbs. 
  2. Each item will display whether you can claim with Orbs or spend money to make your purchase. Select an item to view both pricing options. 
Info: For eligible items, the Shop automatically displays the Orbs price if you have enough Orbs. If you don’t have enough Orbs for an item, the regular monetary price will be displayed instead.
  1. To make a purchase, select your desired item and press Claim in the Shop window.
Important: Discord Orb purchases are final and cannot be refunded.

Orbs Exclusives Shop Items 

Tip: To switch from Orbs to regular payment during purchase confirmation, exit and select the Buy button instead. 

Buy Option in Shop Window

Important Discord Orbs Information

  • Switch between earning and spending Orbs by selecting the buttons in the Shop banner (Orbs Exclusives tab, Quest Home or through your Orbs balance).   
  • Orbs can only be used within Discord–they cannot be converted to real money. 
  • Earned Orbs do not expire once earned, and they remain in your account until you spend them.
  • Orbs are attached to your account and cannot be shared or transferred between users. 

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: I don't see any information about Discord Orbs in my desktop app or browser client. Why not?

A: Orbs is currently in limited Beta access, and isn’t currently available to everyone. You’ll receive an in-app notification when Discord Orbs becomes available to you! 

Q: Are Orbs available on mobile?

A: Not at this time. You can only earn and spend Orbs on the desktop app and browser client.

Q: I noticed I can’t buy a specific Shop item. Why not?

A: You can spend Orbs on most Shop items, including Orbs-exclusive items. However, partner branded Shop items cannot be purchased with Orbs.

Q: Can I refund something I claimed in the Shop with Orbs?

A: Any items you claim in the Shop with Orbs are not refundable. 

Q: If I claim Nitro credits using Orbs, will it apply to my account right away?

A: It depends on if you have an active subscription. See our Help Center article for more information on how Nitro credits work.

Q: Is there a limit to the number of Orbs I can collect?

A: Nope! You can earn and collect as many Orbs as you’d like.

Q: Can I buy or gift Orbs to someone?

A: No, you cannot gift or buy Orbs. The only way to obtain Orbs is through completing Quests.

Q: Is there any other way to obtain Orbs? Can I only earn Orbs from Quests?

A: The only way to earn Orbs is to complete specific Quests that offer Orbs as a reward.

Q: Can I share or trade my Orbs with friends?

A: No, Orbs are tied to your personal Discord account and cannot be transferred between users.

Q: Can I exchange my Orbs for real money or transfer them to other platforms?

A: No, you cannot convert Orbs to real money or transfer them to other platforms.

Q: Will my Orbs ever expire?

A: No, your Orbs stay in your account until you decide to spend them. If you lose access to your Discord account for any reason, including violating our Terms of Service or Community Guidelines, you may lose access to any Orbs associated with that account. 

Q: What happens to my Orbs if I change accounts?

A: Orbs remain tied to the original account where they were earned. They cannot be transferred between accounts, even if both accounts belong to you.

Q: I'm experiencing issues with Discord Orbs. What should I do?

A: Contact Discord Support directly for assistance with any Orbs-related concerns.

Q: What happens to my Orbs if my account is compromised or banned?

A: If you lose access to your Discord account for any reason, including violating our Terms of Service or Community Guidelines, you may lose access to any Orbs associated with that account. For cases involving compromised accounts or fraudulent purchases, please contact our support team for assistance.

Q: What should I do if I see someone selling Orbs?

A: Please report any attempts to sell or trade Orbs, as this violates the Discord Orbs Terms and may result in account penalties.

name: Nameplates FAQ
title: Nameplates FAQ
body:
Make your name stand out with Nameplates! These special designs customize how your name appears in your direct messages (DMs), group chats and servers, giving your name that extra fun and flair wherever you go on Discord.

What this article covers:
  • What are Nameplates?
  • How can I purchase a Nameplate?
    • Desktop/Browser
    • Mobile
  • How do I apply a Nameplate?
    • Desktop/Browser
    • Mobile
  • Where do Nameplates appear?
  • Frequently Asked Questions

What are nameplates?

Nameplates are unique designs that let you customize how your display name appears on Discord. While Avatar Decorations and Profile Effects let you personalize your profile, Nameplates let you add more flair to your name so it stands out with style in your DMs, group chats, and servers.

Example of a Nameplate

How can I purchase a Nameplate?

Nameplates are only available on desktop for purchase, but you can still view others’ Nameplates on mobile.

Desktop/Browser

Accessing the Shop via Shop Tab

You can head over to the Shop to preview and purchase Nameplates.
1. Navigate to your Direct Messages list by selecting the Discord app icon in the upper-left corner.

Direct Messages Icon

2. Then, press the Shop tab [] to the right of the server list to enter the Shop! 

Shop tab

3. Once directed to the Shop, you can preview and buy Nameplates to add to your collection. 

Example of Nameplates in the Shop

Accessing the Shop via User Settings

1. To access your User Settings, select the cogwheel icon [] in the lower-left corner of the app, then navigate to the Profiles section. 

Cogwheel Icon

2. Once there, you will see the banner to the Shop where you can select Check it out. You can also select Change Nameplate and select the Shop icon [] to be redirected to the Shop.  

Access Shop via User Settings

3. Once directed to the Shop, you can preview and buy Nameplates to add to your collection.

Purchased Nameplates get added to your collection, which can be found in User Settings > Profiles > Nameplate. Items available for purchase in the Shop will change periodically.

Mobile

Nameplates are only available on desktop for purchase, but you can view and apply them on mobile.

To enter the Shop on mobile, tap your avatar icon in the bottom-right corner, then tap the Shop icon [] to view Nameplates.

Accessing the Shop on Mobile

How do I apply a Nameplate?

Desktop/Browser

1. On the desktop app or browser, head into your User Settings by selecting the cogwheel []. 

Cogwheel Icon

2. Once directed to your User Settings, select the Profiles tab to view your profile settings. 

3. Then, press the Change Nameplate button to open the Nameplate selection menu. 

Change Nameplate Button

4. Once you have chosen the Nameplate you would like, select Apply.

Selecting a Nameplate

5. After applying your selected Nameplate, confirm your profile changes by selecting Save Changes. 

Save Changes Button

Mobile

Ensure your mobile device is updated to use Nameplates on mobile. 

1. On mobile, tap your avatar icon in the bottom-right corner, then tap Edit Profile.

 

Avatar icon (Left), Edit Profile Button (Right)

2. In the Profile settings, scroll down to Nameplate and tap the field to open the Change Nameplates selection menu. 

3. Choose a Nameplate and tap Apply. 

4. After applying your selected Nameplate, tap Save in the upper-right corner to confirm your changes.

Applying a Nameplate on Mobile

Where do Nameplates appear?

After applying a Nameplate, it will be visible across several key areas of Discord:

  • User Settings bar

Example of Nameplate in User Settings Bar

  • Your DMs and Group Chats
When hovering or selected, the Nameplate will appear for the DM/Group Chat name.

Example of Nameplate in DMs

  • Members Lists within Servers, Channels, and Threads

Example of Nameplate in Members List 

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Can everyone see my Nameplate or just me?

A: Everyone can see your Nameplate.

Q: Do Nitro subscribers get discounts on Nameplates?

A: Yes, Nitro subscribers receive discounts on all items in the Shop, including Nameplates.

Q: Are Nameplates available to purchase and edit on mobile?

A: Currently, you can only purchase and edit Nameplates on desktop. However, Nameplates are visible on both desktop and mobile devices.

Q: Can I get a refund for my Nameplate purchase?

A: While Nameplates are generally non-refundable, as stated in our Refund Policy, if you purchased one during our experimental phase (before April 21, 2025), you can submit a refund request to Discord support here by May 5th, 2025. Otherwise, all Nameplate purchases are final and non-refundable.

Q: Can I refund Nitro after buying a Nameplate?

A: No, if you’ve purchased a Nameplate within 5 days of starting or renewing your Nitro subscription, you will not be eligible to refund your Nitro subscription.

Q: Can Nameplates be turned off? I don't want to see them.

A: Nameplates cannot be disabled, but you can go to User Settings > Accessibility > Enable Reduced Motion to minimize Nameplate animations and effects.

Q: I purchased and applied a Nameplate to my profile - but I don’t see it enabled or active? 

A: Currently, Nameplates show when you are active on Discord—so make sure you are not in invisible mode or offline.

name: How to Verify Age Group
title: How to Verify Age Group
body:
We provide age verification to help users manage content filter settings and sensitive content visibility. This one-time process can be completed when you first adjust these settings, with the option to re-verify if needed.

The age verification features described are an experiment and available only to users in the United Kingdom and Australia.

What this article covers:

  • Why do I need to verify my age group?
  • When do I need to verify my age?
  • How do I verify my age group?
  • Frequently Asked Questions

Why do I need to verify my age group?

Some Discord settings and content are designed for certain age groups. We're experimenting with a streamlined way for you to verify your age group when you try to access those settings or content.

NOTE: Age verification is required to unblur media flagged by our sensitive media filter and to update your sensitive media filter settings.

When do I need to verify my age?

You may be asked to verify your age in two situations:

1. When you encounter content flagged by our sensitive media filter, you may need to verify your age group.

Example of Blurred Sensitive Media in a Message

2. When you try to change your sensitive content filter settings and need to verify your age first. 

Sensitive Content Settings in Content & Social

How do I verify my age group?

The age verification process works the same way, regardless of how it is triggered. Here’s how to verify to verify your age group:

1. When you encounter blurred sensitive content or try to change content filter settings, you'll be prompted to verify your age if you haven't done so already. This requirement applies to users who haven't verified their age and are included in this experiment.

Example of Verify age group window

2. A We need to verify your age window will appear, offering two verification options: 

  • Option 1: Face Scan 
    • Select Face Scan on the verification page. 
    • Allow access to your camera when prompted.
    • Follow the on-screen instructions to complete the scan. 
    • Press Done to submit.
  • Option 2: Scan ID 
    • Select Scan ID on the verification page. 
    • Use your mobile device to scan the QR code.
    • Take a clear photo of your ID following the guidelines.
    • Press Done to submit.

Face Scan and Scan ID options in the Age Verification window

After verification, you'll receive system messages about the verification process and a Direct Message from Discord's official profile confirming your verified age group.

Example of direct message (DM) notification from Discord confirming your age verification status

If the verification fails, you can either try again or contact our Trust & Safety team to request a manual review.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Is my data stored when I use Face Scan or ID verification?

A: The information you share to power the age verification method that you choose is only used for the one-time age verification process and is not stored by Discord or its vendor. For Face Scan, the solution our vendor uses operates on-device, which means there is no collection of any biometric information when you scan your face. For ID verification, the scan of your ID is deleted upon verification.

Q: Do I need to verify my age to access content flagged by our Sensitive Media Filter and settings?

A: Yes, age verification is required before you can access that flagged content and the sensitive media filter settings.

Q: Do I need to verify my age multiple times to change the settings for the Sensitive Media Filter?

A: No. Age verification is a one-time process. Once your age group is confirmed, you won't need to verify again when you attempt to access an age-restricted feature. However, if you believe your age group is incorrect, you may retry the age verification process again.

Q: What happens if my age group is verified incorrectly or it fails to verify.

A: You have two options:

  1. Retry verification through your chat with Discord system messages where you can select Retry to enter the verification flow again.
  2. You can retry by opting for a manual review here. 

Q: How long does verification take?

A: The verification process typically takes just a few minutes. You'll receive notifications about the status and a DM from Discord's official profile once completed.

Example of DM notification from Discord confirming your age verification status

Q: What happens if I’m banned after age verification?

A: Your account may be banned if your age is below the minimum requirement. If you believe the result is incorrect, you can submit an appeal through the underage appeals process here.

name: How to Use Voice Filters on Discord
title: How to Use Voice Filters on Discord
body:
Voice filters are designed to change how you sound in voice and video calls. They add a creative and engaging touch to conversations through the desktop app and make interactions more fun and expressive.

What this article covers:
  • What are voice filters?
  • How to Use Voice Filters
    • How to Enable Playback
    • Previewing a Voice Filter
    • Removing a Voice Filter
  • Frequently Asked Questions
[Beta] Voice filters is currently an experiment and available to a limited group of users on Windows desktop only.

What are voice filters?

You can choose from a variety of voice filters to change how you sound on voice and video calls. Voice filters provide additional options for modifying your voice and allow you to sound how you want no matter what you’re up to–epic story telling for roleplay, hyping up your team or just hanging with friends. 

Some voice filters are always free to use at any time, while some are locked. You can get access to the full collection for even more ways to customize your voice with a Nitro subscription.

NOTE: While this feature is in experimentation, your mic quality will affect how clear voice filters sound. If you're finding your filtered voice is difficult to understand, try switching to a different microphone to improve the sound quality.

How to Use Voice Filters

1. To navigate to your Microphone Settings, tap the drop-down arrow [] located to the bottom-left of the app, next to the mic icon [].

Microphone Settings drop-down arrow icon 

2. Select any of the available options to apply the voice filter to your input audio.

Example of available voice filter options in Discord

3. When a voice filter has been applied, a banner will appear letting you know which one is currently active.

Example of what it looks like when you have a voice filter enabled.

How to Enable Playback 

With playback enabled, you'll hear your voice with the filter applied played back with a slight delay as you speak. This way, you can hear yourself as others do. Playback is on by default, but you can always easily disable and enable it. 

NOTE:Using headsets is highly recommended when playback is enabled, to avoid a feedback loop.

1. Navigate to your Microphone Settings by tapping the drop-down arrow [] located to the bottom-left of the app, located next to the mic icon [].

Microphone Settings drop-down arrow icon 

2. After applying a voice filter, you can tap on the ear icon [] to enable audio playback. To disable, tap the same icon.

Example of playback icon

Previewing a Voice Filter

Before you decide what voice filter is right for you, you can preview each one that is available and listen to the example audio. 

1. Navigate to your Microphone Settings by tapping drop-down arrow [] located to the bottom-left of the app, located next to the mic icon [].

Microphone Settings drop-down arrow icon

2. Hover over each available voice filter and then press on the play icon [] to preview each voice filter.

Preview Voice icon

Removing a Voice Filter

1. Tap the drop-down arrow located to the bottom-left of the app to navigate to Microphone Settings.

Microphone Settings drop-down arrow icon 

2. Tap the X located on the right-hand side of the active voice filter banner to disable the voice filter.

X button to remove the applied voice filter

NOTE: Have feedback about voice filters? We'd love to hear from you! Share your thoughts in our feedback forum to help us improve this experimental feature.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How come I don’t see voice filters? Can I request voice filters?

A: No, voice filters are currently in experimentation and only available to a limited group of users.

Q: Do voice filters stay on for all calls or do I need to set it up for each call?

A: A voice filter stays enabled unless you remove it. To remove a voice filter, simply tap the drop-down arrow [] located to the right of the mic icon [] and tap on the X located in the right-hand side of the active voice filter banner.

X button to remove the applied voice filter

Q: How can I tell if I have a voice filter active?

A: You can tell a voice filter is currently active by checking your mic indicator in the bottom-left corner of the Discord app. If a voice filter is active your microphone icon will have a star on it.

Example of microphone icon when a voice filter enabled

Q: Why do I not have access to all the voice filters? How do the daily free filters work?

A: Voice filters that aren’t grayed out are always available. Filters with a clock icon [] are part of the rotating free selection. When the timer reaches zero, a new set of free filters will be available for a limited time. Filters that are grayed out can be unlocked with Nitro.

Example of a voice filter with the clock icon

Q: Does Discord store my voice data?
A: Discord does not store any voice data or use voice data for any identifying purposes. Voice filters are synthesized on your device.

name: Nitro Quest Perk
title: Nitro Quest Perk
body:
Discord Nitro subscribers will gain extended access to Quest avatar decoration rewards - allowing them to use the new rewards for longer and restore previously expired decorations. This premium feature enhances your customization options across all Discord platforms.

What this article covers:
  • Understanding the Nitro Quest Perk
  • Finding Your Quest Avatar Decorations
    • Desktop
    • Mobile
  • Frequently Asked Questions

Understanding the Nitro Quest Perk

Normally, avatar decorations earned through Quests are available for two months. However, Nitro subscribers get an exclusive perk: the ability to keep many of these decorations for an extended period. We're working to make even more Quest rewards eligible for this benefit.

Requirements to utilize the Nitro Quest Perk:

  • This benefit is exclusively for Nitro subscribers on the standard plan (not available for Nitro Basic or Classic).
  • You must have claimed the decoration reward after completing a Quest to be eligible for extended access.
NOTE:
  • Not all avatar decorations will be eligible for this perk. Eligible rewards will be indicated during the Quest completion experience.
  • If the earned avatar decoration has an expiration date, it will be listed under the specific avatar decoration in Profile Settings > Change Decoration.

Finding Your Quest Avatar Decorations

Once you've earned a Quest decoration, you can easily access and equip it through your User Settings.

NOTE: For more information about avatar decorations in general, check out our Avatar Decorations article.

Desktop

1. To access your Quest-earned avatar decorations on desktop, head into your User Settings by selecting the cogwheel []. 

The User Settings Icon (Cogwheel) in Discord's Desktop App

2. Once redirected to your User Settings, select the Profiles tab to view your profile settings. 

Accessing Your Profile Through the Profile Tab

3. Then, press the Change Decorations button to open the avatar decoration selection menu.  

4. Under the Your Decorations section, you will find your Quest-earned avatar decorations. 

5. Select Apply once you have chosen the Quest-earned avatar decoration to preview your current avatar decoration. 

Example of a Quest avatar decoration under Your Decoration section

6. After you apply an avatar decoration, you will need to confirm your changes by selecting Save Changes. 

Select "Save Changes" to Apply Your Avatar Decoration

Mobile

1. On your mobile device, head into your User Settings by tapping your avatar. 

The User Settings Icon (Cogwheel) in Discord's Mobile App

2. From here, select Edit Profile. 

This will navigate you to the Profile page where you can tap Avatar Decoration to navigate to the Change Decoration page. You can also tap on your avatar and select the Change Decoration option instead.  

Accessing Your Profile by Pressing “Edit Profile”

3. In the Change Decoration menu, under the Your Decorations section, you’ll find your Quest-earned avatar decorations. Select the desired avatar decoration you’d like to apply. 

4. Once you’ve found an avatar decoration you want to use, tap Apply then Save in the upper-right corner to confirm your changes. 

  

Example of Setting an Avatar Decoration   

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Will I lose access to my decorations if my Nitro subscription expires or I downgrade to Nitro Basic?

A: Yes, you will lose access to these decorations. Extended access to Quest-earned avatar decorations requires an active Nitro subscription. If your subscription expires or you downgrade your subscription to Nitro Basic, you'll lose access to the decorations until you re-subscribe.

Q: Can I regain access to decorations from Quests I completed in the past?

A: Not all past avatar decoration rewards are available - however, Nitro members can access some of the decorations they previously earned by completing Quests and claiming the rewards. You can see which decorations are available at Profile Settings > Change Decoration.

Q: Do I need to complete the Quest again to get the decoration back?
A: No. If you previously completed the Quest and claimed the reward, you'll automatically regain access to eligible decorations when you subscribe to Nitro.

Q: Is this Nitro perk applicable to all decoration rewards from Quests?
A: No, not all decorations rewards from Quest are eligible for this Nitro Perk. If decoration reward is not eligible, you will see an expiry date listed under the specific decoration in Profile Settings > Change Decoration.

Q: How do I know how long I can keep a Quest-earned avatar decoration?
A: If the Quest-earned avatar decoration has an expiration date, it will be listed under the specific avatar decoration in Profile Settings > Change Decoration.

name: Server Member Applications
title: Server Member Applications
body:
Learn how to manage Discord server members through applications, invite-only settings, and server discovery. Here we'll show you everything server owners need to know about controlling member access, reviewing applications, and customizing join requirements.

What this article covers:
  • Understanding Server Member Applications
  • How to Configure Server Join Settings
    • Invite Only
    • Apply to Join
    • Discoverable
  • Reviewing Server Member Applications
    • Processing Server Member Applications
  • Frequently Asked Questions

Understanding Server Member Applications

The server member applications feature is rolling out gradually and can only be enabled through the desktop app. However, users applying for a server can submit or withdraw their applications using either desktop or mobile devices.

People can join your server in three ways:

  • Invite only
  • Through Discovery
  • Member application

Using member applications, server owners can precisely control who joins their server. Simply navigate to your Access settings, by pressing the server name in the upper-left corner. Then select Server Settings > Access.

Accessing Server Member Applications

How to Configure Server Join Settings

In Access settings, you can control your server's privacy level by choosing how people join. Select either Invite Only, Apply to Join, or Discoverable under the How can people join your server? section.

Server Join Setting Options: Invite Only, Apply to Join, and Discoverable

Invite Only

Invite Only is the default privacy setting for all Discord servers. This gives you maximum control over who joins your server:

  • Members can only join through valid invite links
  • Enable server rules to require new members to accept your server guidelines before participating
  • Generate customized invite links with expiration dates and usage limits

Invite Only Option

Apply to Join

While applications are pending, users cannot view any server content.

With the Apply to Join option, you can screen potential members by requiring them to complete an application form before joining your server. Here's what you need to know:

  • All applications must be reviewed and approved by server administrators before members can join
  • Create custom questions to ensure new members are a good fit for your community
  • Choose whether to display application links on per-server profile for easier discovery

Apply to Join Option

NOTE: Server members who have the Kick Members permission enabled can create special invite links that bypass the application process. These invite links can be viewed in Server Settings > Invites.

Discoverable

The Discoverable option lets you enable Server Discovery, making your server visible to all Discord users who are searching for new communities:

  • Your server must be set up as a Community server to be discoverable
  • You'll need to meet Discord's discovery eligibility requirements including safety standards
  • Anyone can join and find your server directly through Server Discovery

Discoverable Option

Reviewing Server Member Applications

If your server’s privacy level was set to Apply to Join, server administrators with the appropriate permissions can manage member applications through the Members page. You can learn more about the Members page here.

If a user has applied to join your server, you will notice a notification located next to the Members tab located above the server’s channel list. In the Members page, select the user’s server member application.

You will be able to review the following information:

  • Why they would like to join your server
  • When they joined Discord
  • When they submitted their server member application

Reviewing a Server Members Application in Members Page

Processing Server Member Applications

When reviewing server member applications, you have three processing options:

  • Approve: This grants the user access to your server.
  • Reject: This denies the user access to your server. To permanently prevent a user from reapplying, you can ban them from the server.
  • Interview: You can choose to directly message and interview the user before making your final decision to approve or reject their application.

Example of Selecting Interview

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How long does it take to review server member applications?

A: The review time varies depending on your server administrators' availability. There is no set timeframe.

Q: Can users edit their server member applications after submitting?

A: No, users cannot edit their applications after submission. However, they can withdraw their application and submit a new one if needed.

Q: Who can review server member applications?

A: Server administrators and members with appropriate permissions (specifically those with the Kick Members permission) can review and process member applications.

Q: What happens if a server member application is rejected?

A: When an application is rejected, the user will be notified and will not gain access to the server. They can choose to apply again unless they have been banned by server administrators.

Q: Can I customize the server member application questions?

A: Yes, server administrators can create custom questions to better screen potential members and ensure they're a good fit for the community.

Q: Do server member applications work on mobile devices?

A: While the feature can only be enabled through the desktop app, users can submit and withdraw applications using either desktop or mobile devices.

name: 3 Months YouTube Premium for Discord Nitro Users Promo FAQ
title: 3 Months YouTube Premium for Discord Nitro Users Promo FAQ

    • Step By Step Claim Instructions

    • Eligibility for Redeeming the YouTube Premium

What is Discord Nitro?

Discord Nitro is our membership plan that gives you access to special perks that’ll make your time on Discord as fun as ever! Personalize and enhance your experience with popular perks like HD streaming, 500MB file uploads, profile and avatar customizations, 2 free Server Boosts, and more:

  • Custom Emojis
  • Discord App Color Themes
  • Super Reactions
  • Avatar Decorations
  • Unique Server Profiles
  • Server Boosts
  • More Nitro & Nitro Basic perks

What is YouTube Premium?

YouTube Premium. All YouTube. No interruptions. Now you can watch videos ad-free, keep them playing in the background, and download them to watch anytime, anywhere. You even get uninterrupted access to the YouTube Music app where you can listen to over 100 million official songs ad-free, offline, and in the background. With YouTube Premium, there’s nothing stopping you from playing your favorites. Learn more here.

How do I claim the YouTube Premium in Discord?

Eligibility for the Claiming this Promotion in Discord

  • If you are an active Discord Nitro member, the code must be claimed in the Gift Inventory by April 15, 2025 (11:59PM PT).

Unfortunately, if you are a Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting member, you'll need to become a Nitro member in order to claim this promotion.

Step By Step Claim Instructions

You may notice a notification bar at the top of your browser/desktop app, and you can press the "Take me there" button in the notification bar to be redirected to your Gift Inventory. 

For both the desktop/browser app and mobile app, you can also directly head to your User Settings, and then select Gift Inventory.

How do I share my Code with a Friend?

To share the code, you can copy the 12-character code from the Gift Inventory (in your User Settings in the Discord app) and then share this code to a friend in a Direct Message.

Frequently Asked Questions

Promotion Details

After April 15, 2025 (11:59PM PT), Nitro members will no longer be able to claim a trial code.

Q: Can I redeem the YouTube Premium promotion to my YouTube account in my region?

Claiming and Redemption Process

name: How to Maintain your Nitro and Server Boost Subscription Streaks
title: How to Maintain your Nitro and Server Boost Subscription Streaks
body:
What this article covers:
  • What is a Subscription Streak?
  • How to Maintain Your Nitro Badge Subscription Streak
  • How to Maintain Your Server Boost Subscription Streak
  • How do I Transfer my Server Boost to Maintain my streak?
  • Frequently Asked Questions

What is a Subscription Streak?

Nitro and Server Boosting Badge streaks

A subscription streak is how long you’ve been subscribed to Nitro or Server Boosting a server. The longer you’ve consistently been subscribed, the bigger your streak will be. Your streak can be reset if you are no longer subscribed to Nitro or if you’re not actively boosting a server with a Server Boost.

How to Maintain Your Nitro Badge Subscription Streak

Example of Nitro Badge and subscription streak

Any user that has a Nitro, Nitro Basic, or Nitro Classic subscription will have a Nitro badge on their profile. In order to maintain your Nitro badge streak, you must remain subscribed to Nitro, Nitro Basic, or Nitro Classic. 

If your subscription has ended, you have 7 days to renew your subscription in order to maintain your streak.

You can view your boosting streak by tapping on your avatar icon to reveal your profile and hovering over your Nitro badge.

GIF showing how to view your Nitro badge streak

Note: If your subscription streak has been lost, our Support Team can not adjust your streak.

How to Maintain Your Server Boost Subscription Streak

Note: If you have been removed or left a server that you were boosting, you will have a 7 day cooldown before you can use your boost again. Learn more about transferring a boost below.

If you are also switching your purchase from desktop to mobile or vice versa, you have 72 hours to manually reactivate your Server Boosts in order to not lose your streak.

Server Boosting Badge Streak through User Profile

Your Server Boosting Badge and streak is based on the length of time that you started boosting a server. 

Note: Regardless of how many servers you boost, the length of your streak is dependent on the oldest applied server boost(s)

You can view your boosting streak by tapping on your avatar icon to reveal your profile and hovering over your Server Boosting badge.

GIF showing how to view your Server Boosting badge streak

You can lose your boosting streak for any of the following reasons:

  • You cancel your Server Boost(s)
  • Your Nitro (with 2 included Server Boosts) or your Server Boost(s) subscription has ended
  • The server you have been boosting has been deleted 
  • You’ve been removed from the server by an admin or moderator
Note: If you stop boosting a server for any of the listed reasons, you have 72 hours to reapply your boosts to a new server in order to maintain your streak. If you do not boost another server within 72 hours, you will lose your streak and our Support Team can not adjust your streak.

As long as you keep boosting your favorite server, that badge will continue to evolve while you reach extra levels. 

Example of Server Boost Badge streak evolution                                      

How do I Transfer my Server Boost to Maintain my Streak?

Note: After using your Server Boost, you’ll need to wait 7 days for the cooldown before transferring it to another server.

If you accidentally boosted the wrong server, or you just want to move your boost, you can easily transfer your Server Boost to another server! Just keep in mind, if you move your boost to another server, the original server might lose a server boost level. Here’s how to transfer your boost.

1. Head into your User Settings by pressing the cogwheel [] icon.

 

Cogwheel Icon on Desktop/Browser

2. Navigate to the Server Boost tab.

3. Here you should see the current servers that your Server Boosts are applied to. Tap on the ellipsis [] to the Server Boost that you want to move, and then tap on Transfer Boost.

4. You can either search for the name of the server you want to transfer the boost to, or you can tap on Transfer here if you see the server in the list. In order for a server to show up in the list, you must be a member of the server.

5. Now just tap on Yes, Transfer Boost to transfer the Server Boost.

6. Finally you’ll see a confirmation message stating it has been transferred successfully.

Example of Transferring a Server Boost to Another Server

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: My streak reset and I believe this is incorrect, what should I do? 

A: Discord cannot restore streaks under any circumstances. If you think your streak was incorrectly reset, first verify that you have an active subscription.

If your subscription expired due to past due payments and you had to restart it, remember to manually reapply your server boosts within 72 hours of reactivating your Nitro subscription.

Q: My streak date appears incorrect. What should I do?

A: The streak calculation differs between products: Nitro subscription streaks are based on the subscription date, while Server Boost streaks start from when you begin boosting a server. Since purchases use Universal Time (UTC), the displayed date may differ by up to 24 hours from your local time.

name: How to Connect your Bluesky account to Discord
title: How to Connect your Bluesky account to Discord
body:
What this article covers:
  • What is Bluesky?
  • How to Connect Bluesky to your Discord Account
  • An Unknown Error Occurred. Maybe check your handle?
  • Using a Custom Domain with Bluesky
    • Custom PDS Providers
    • did:web: accounts

What is Bluesky?

Bluesky is a social media platform that allows you to post short messages, photos, videos and more. 

How to Connect Bluesky to your Discord Account

1. Head into your User Settings by pressing the cogwheel [] icon.

2. Tap on the Connections tab and then the Bluesky butterfly icon. 

Connections tab under User Settings

3. Type in your handle for Bluesky and then follow the on-screen instructions to connect your account.

Example of where you enter your Bluesky Account handle

4. You’ll know you’ve successfully connected when you receive this confirmation message:

Confirmation window that your Bluesky account has been connected to Discord

An Unknown Error Occurred. Maybe check your handle?

If we can’t find a Bluesky account associated with the handle you enter, you'll see an error message like this:

Error example when the wrong handle has been entered

This usually means you’ve made a typo when entering the handle, so please make sure to double-check the account name that you have entered. 

If your account uses a custom domain or custom PDS, see Using a Custom Domain with Bluesky below for more details. Otherwise, it’s possible that you may be hitting a temporary server error due to excessive load on the Bluesky network and you’ll have to try connecting your Bluesky account again later.

Using a Custom Domain with Bluesky

In order to link a Bluesky account with a custom-domain handle, Discord will need to look up your account’s DID. This happens when you initially connect the Bluesky account on Discord and then on an ongoing basis to keep your account connected to Discord. 

Verification happens in the same way described in the AT Protocol documentation and the Bluesky blog.

When verifying a domain using the /.well-known/atproto-did method, Discord will use a user-agent string in the form of Discord/1.0 (Discord API; +https://discordapp.com. 

Please ensure that your web server does not block requests with this user-agent, or severely rate-limit requests to this endpoint.

You can simulate the request Discord will make to verify your handle using a curl command in this form: curl -H 'User-Agent: Discord/1.0 (Discord API; +https://discordapp.com)' https://{your-handle-here}/.well-known/atproto-did

Custom PDS Providers

Discord supports linking AT Protocol accounts hosted by third-party PDS providers in the same way as accounts hosted by Bluesky. If hosting your own PDS, please ensure that your web server allows Discord’s user-agent on the authentication and PDS data endpoints, in addition to the /.well-known/atproto-did endpoint.

did:web: accounts

Discord also supports linking AT Protocol accounts that use did:web: identifiers. The requirements for the /.well-known/atproto-did endpoint also apply to the /.well-known/did.json endpoint.

Note: If you run into any issues with linking your Bluesky account to your Discord account, please reach out to our support team through here: http://dis.gd/contact

name: Evolving Nitro Badges
title: Evolving Nitro Badges
body:
Learn about Discord Nitro's evolving profile badges, which show how long you've been a Nitro subscriber and automatically update to celebrate your membership milestones.

What this article covers:
  • What are Evolving Nitro Badges?
  • How Evolving Badges Work
  • Checking Your Nitro Badge Progress
    • Desktop
    • Mobile
  • Frequently Asked Questions

What are Evolving Nitro Badges?

All Nitro subscribers get a special profile badge when they sign up for Nitro. When you’re subscribed to Nitro, your profile badge will evolve to showcase different designs with each milestone that you reach. 

NOTE: The evolving version of the Nitro badge is not available for Nitro Basic or Classic. 

How Evolving Badges Work

Your Nitro badge will automatically evolve once you’ve reached each subscription milestone. The badge that displays on your profile will be the most recent milestone that you’ve reached. 

Nitro Milestone Badge Evolution

If your Nitro subscription ends at any time and you resubscribe later, your badge progression will start fresh from the beginning. This means you'll need to maintain an active subscription to maintain your badge progress.

Checking Your Nitro Badge Progress

Desktop

To check your current badge level and when you'll reach the next milestone, just hover your cursor over the badge on your profile. You can also check your progress under Direct Messages > Nitro Tab.

On Desktop: Evolving Profile Badge Card in Nitro Tab

Mobile

Evolving Nitro Badges on mobile is currently an experiment available to a limited number of users.

1. To check your current badge level on mobile, tap your avatar in the bottom right corner.  

2. Then tap the cogwheel icon [] to enter your Settings > Manage Nitro.

   

On Mobile: Avatar Icon and Settings Icon (Left), Manage Nitro Settings (Right)

3. In your Nitro Home, you’ll find the Evolving Profile Badge card where you can select See All Badges to view your current badge progress.

 

On Mobile: Evolving Profile Badge Card (Left), Nitro Badge Milestones (Right)

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What happens to my badge if I cancel or end my Nitro subscription?

A: If you cancel your Nitro subscription, your badge progression will reset. When you resubscribe, you'll start fresh from the beginning of the badge progression.

NOTE: The Discord Support team does not have the ability to update, change, or restore the evolving Nitro badge or any previous badge progress under any circumstances.

Q: Can I keep my evolved badge if I switch between Nitro and Nitro Basic?

A: The evolving version of the Nitro profile badge is only available with Nitro. If you decide to switch your subscription to Nitro Basic, your badge progression will reset and will not evolve. If you re-subscribe to Nitro after subscribing to Nitro Basic, you will start fresh from the beginning of the badge progression. 

Q: How do I view my current badge progress?

A: Simply hover your cursor over the Nitro badge on your profile to see your current level and when you'll reach the next milestone or visit Direct Messages > Nitro Tab > press on the Evolving Profile Badge card to view where you are in the progression of available badges.

Q: Can I choose which badge design to display?

A: No, the badge that is displayed on your profile will be the last milestone you reached and cannot be manually selected.

Q: Can I hide or remove my Nitro badge?

A: No, the Nitro badge cannot be hidden or removed from your profile once earned.

name: Emoji Confetti FAQ
title: Emoji Confetti FAQ
body:
Want to make a Discord message stand out? Emoji Confetti lets you add pizzazz to any message! Sharing your epic gaming moments or posting server announcements is going to be a lot more fun and memorable.

What this article covers:
  • What is Emoji Confetti?
  • Why and When should I use Emoji Confetti?
  • How do I apply Emoji Confetti to a message?
  • Frequently Asked Questions

What is Emoji Confetti?

Emoji Confetti is an experimental feature currently available to select desktop users.

Emoji Confetti adds eye-catching flair to your Discord messages. Pick an emoji and watch it burst as confetti on any message—yours or someone else's—to make it stand out with personality and pizzazz.

Example of Emoji Confetti

Why and When should I use Emoji Confetti?

Emoji Confetti turns ordinary messages into extraordinary ones, going beyond standard emoji reactions to create more fun moments and interactions in your conversations.

Here are moments where adding Emoji Confetti to a message can be a game-changer:

  • Celebrations: If someone posted a message of a gaming milestone or accomplishing a personal goal, shower that message with emoji confetti!
  • Special Announcements: Make important messages stand out in busy conversations or dedicated announcement channels.
  • Spreading Joy & Appreciation: Add confetti to messages to brighten someone’s day or show your appreciation.
  • Just for Fun: Sometimes a conversation needs that extra touch of magic - no special occasion required!

How do I apply Emoji Confetti to a message?

1. To apply Emoji Confetti to a message, select the Add Emoji Confetti icon [] when hovering over a posted message or in the lower-right corner of the text box while typing.

Add Emoji Confetti Icon While Hovering a Message or in Text Chat 

NOTE: As part of this experiment, start your Emoji Confetti fun with 2 free Emoji Confetti!

2. To add Emoji Confetti when typing a message, press the emoji icon [] in the Select an emoji to apply to your message banner located above the text box. Then, choose an emoji from the emoji picker. 

Selecting the Emoji Icon in the Banner Above the Text Box

For a posted message, pick an emoji using the Pick Emoji box. Then, choose an emoji from the emoji picker.

Selecting the Pick Emoji Box to and Choosing an Emoji from the Picker

3. Once you've sent your message or applied confetti to an existing message, you're all set! Hover over the emoji on a message with Emoji Confetti applied to cause an explosion of confetti!

Hovering over Messages with Emoji Confetti

Ready for even more fun? Get a pack of 5 additional Emoji Confetti for $0.99. To purchase more, simply open the Emoji Confetti menu by selecting the Add Emoji Confetti icon [] and press Get 5 more for $0.99.

Get 5 more for $0.99 Button in Emoji Confetti Menu

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What platforms is Emoji Confetti available on?

A: Currently, Emoji Confetti can only be applied to messages on desktop devices.

Q: Is there a way to disable the Emoji Confetti explosion?

A: The confetti explosion is an opt-in effect that you can choose to trigger. You can disable the Emoji Confetti effect and reduce motion across the app by going to your User Settings > Accessibility > toggle Enable Reduced Motion. You can learn more about reduced motion here.

Q: What’s your refund policy for Emoji Confetti?

A: Emoji Confetti is non-refundable—we cannot provide refunds after purchase or use.

Q: Can I see who applied Emoji Confetti to a message?

A: Yes—simply hover your cursor over the CONFETTI badge on a message to see who applied it.

Example of CONFETTI Badge

Q: Can everyone in the server see Emoji Confetti on a message?
A: Yes, everyone in the server can see Emoji Confetti on a message and trigger the effect. However, Emoji Confetti that you trigger will only appear for you.

Q: Can I remove or change Emoji Confetti after applying it?
A: No, once you’ve applied Emoji Confetti to a message, it cannot be removed or modified.

Q: What happens to Emoji Confetti after the experiment ends?

A: As an experimental feature, Emoji Confetti on messages and any remaining in your inventory may expire in the future.

name: Safe Ways to Shop on Discord
title: Safe Ways to Shop on Discord
body:
Looking for safe ways to buy Discord Nitro and other premium features? Learn how to protect your account and payment information by purchasing through official Discord channels only.

From accessing Nitro perks to enjoying premium features, ensuring your purchases are made through authorized platforms is key to protecting your Discord account.

Purchases from unauthorized sellers can potentially lead to revoked purchases or compromised personal and payment information. This article will help you understand the official ways to purchase Discord products and stay safe while enjoying all that Discord has to offer.

What this article covers:
  • Official Ways to Buy or Receive Discord Products
  • What Can You Do If You Suspect You’ve Been Scammed?
    • How to Stay Informed to Stay Safe
  • Frequently Asked Questions

Official Ways to Buy or Receive Discord Products

The secure way to purchase Nitro or other Discord products is directly through Discord or our official Amazon store (available in select countries).

Here’s how you can purchase or receive Nitro and other products on Discord:

  • Direct Purchase: Buy Nitro and Server Boosts through the Nitro Tab in your Direct Messages List or under User Settings > Billing Settings 
  • Gift Inventory: Check and manage your purchased or received Nitro gifts within the app. Gifts sent through Discord can only be redeemed on the platform. Learn how to securely claim a Nitro gift in our Nitro Gifting FAQ.
  • Profile Purchases: Customize your experience by purchasing Profile Cosmetics and Effects through the Shop Tab in your Direct Messages List or under User Settings > Profile
  • Share Nitro Program: As a subscription perk for Nitro subscribers, you can share three 2-week trial passes with friends who don't already have Nitro. This official program is a secure way to spread the fun. For more details, check out our Share Nitro article.
  • Quests and Promotions: We're proud of Nitro and want you to experience it firsthand! That's why we regularly offer opportunities to try it before buying. Check out our Quests & Promotions page to see all current offers.

If you ever encounter a promotion or offer for Nitro, make sure it comes from one of the trusted sources outlined above. Avoid clicking on suspicious links or interacting with third-party sellers offering discounts or giveaways.

Discord's premium products can only be purchased directly through the Discord app or our official Amazon store (available in select countries). Buying Discord Nitro or other official products from unauthorized sources puts you at risk of scams.

What Can You Do If You Suspect You’ve Been Scammed? 

If you suspect you’ve been scammed or purchased Discord products from an unauthorized seller:

1. Contact Support: Reach out to our support team at https://dis.gd/billing for assistance.

2. Report Fraud: Report the issue at https://dis.gd/howtoreport to help us take action against scammers.

Please note that Discord cannot mediate financial disputes or issue refunds for purchases made through unauthorized third-party sellers.

How to Stay Informed to Stay Safe

Scammers are constantly looking for ways to exploit users. Always double-check that your purchases and gifts come from the official Discord sources described in this article. For more guidance on avoiding scams, check out these resources:

  • Understanding and Avoiding Common Scams
  • Deceptive Practices Policy Explainer
  • Claiming a Nitro Gift FAQ
  • Shop FAQ
  • Server Boosting FAQ

By staying vigilant and following these tips, you can enjoy Discord’s premium features with peace of mind.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How do you identify a third-party seller?

A: Third-party sellers are unauthorized individuals or websites that offer Discord products at discounted prices or through unofficial channels. These sellers often advertise through unsolicited messages, social media, or unofficial websites. To identify them, look for offers that require external payments, unusual URLs, or methods that don’t involve the Discord app or official Amazon store. Remember: if it’s not from a Discord source described in this article, it’s not official.

Q: What does a phishing attempt look like?

A: Phishing attempts often appear as fake messages or links designed to trick you into providing sensitive information, like your login credentials or payment details. Common signs include:

  • Messages claiming you’ve won or received free products or rewards, like Nitro, but requiring you to click a suspicious link.
  • Threats to your account status unless you take immediate action.
  • Requests for your password, account login, or personal information.

Discord will never ask for your login details or for your payment information through unsolicited messages. Always verify links and contact Discord support directly if you’re unsure.

Q: What are safe messaging practices to avoid unsolicited scams?

A: To protect yourself from unsolicited messages and scams:

  • Avoid engaging with messages from unknown users, especially those offering deals or rewards.
  • Enable Safe Direct Messaging under User Settings > Privacy & Safety to automatically scan DMs from non-friends for harmful content.
  • Report suspicious messages or users by following the steps outlined here.
  • Never click on links from untrusted sources. Even if they appear to come from someone you know, accounts can be compromised.

If you ever need to verify if a source is a legitimate Discord source or not, you can reach out to the Discord support team.

name: Why Does My Payment Show As A Pending Charge?
title: Why Does My Payment Show As A Pending Charge?
body:
What this article covers:
  • What is a Pending Charge?
  • What if I See Multiple Pending Charges?

What is a Pending Charge?

Example of a Pending purchase in the Billing tab

If you see a pending charge on Discord, this indicates that the charge was unsuccessful because it requires further verification from your bank or card provider. You’ll need to reach out to your payment provider for steps on how to correct this pending charge. 

If the pending charge isn't resolved, it will automatically cancel within 3 days. The status of the charge will then change to Failed in your User Settings > Billing. If a pending charge still appears on your bank statement, it should be removed within 5-10 business days.

What if I see Multiple Pending Charges?

The only time you may see multiple pending charges are when your payments have not been successfully processed, or they’re in a Past Due state. 

When renewing a subscription and your renewal payment does not successfully go through, we will attempt the purchase again to ensure that your subscription goes uninterrupted. Once a payment successfully goes through, our system will attempt to cancel all other pending payments. 

Note: If you are still seeing the pending charge after 10 business days, you can reach out to the Billing Support team for them to review through here: dis.gd/billing

name: Why is My Payment Showing as Failed or Invalid?
title: Why is My Payment Showing as Failed or Invalid?
body:
What this article covers:
  • Why is My Payment Showing As Failed?
  • Why is My Payment showing as Invalid Payment?

Why is my Payment Showing As Failed?

Billing tab under User Settings on desktop/browser

There are several reasons that can cause a payment to fail. To figure out what’s going on, we recommend following the steps below:

1. Ensure that the billing address associated with the card being charged is current and matches the information filed with your bank. You can learn how to manage your billing information here.

2. Ensure your card details are entered correctly.

3. Ensure the card hasn’t expired.

4. Depending on the card, ensure there are sufficient funds in the account or that the credit limit hasn’t been exceeded.

5. It’s possible a pre-set spending limit on the card was reached. Double-check if a spending limit has been set.

Note: If issues persist after following the steps above, Discord's Support team cannot provide further assistance. We recommend contacting your bank or using another payment method.

Why is my Payment showing as Invalid Payment?

If you’re receiving an Invalid payment error message, it means there is an error with the payment method you are trying to use. Please review the information you provided and try again. 

Example of an Invalid payment message when making a purchase

Note: If you’re still getting an error message, please reach out to our Support team for further assistance through here: dis.gd/billing

name: Discord Advertising IAB Addendum
title: Discord Advertising IAB Addendum
body:
Updated May 16, 2025

This Discord Advertising IAB Addendum (this “Discord Addendum”), which amends and supplements the IAB STANDARD TERMS AND CONDITIONS FOR INTERNET ADVERTISING FOR MEDIA BUYS ONE YEAR OR LESS VERSION 3.0 (the “IAB Terms” and collectively with this Discord Addendum, the “Campaign Terms”), governs and forms a part of any applicable insertion order  (the “IO”) signed by and between Discord Inc. (“Media Company”) and the advertiser designated on an IO (“Advertiser”), or, if applicable, Advertiser’s agency designated on an IO (“Agency”).  The terms of this Discord Addendum will control over and fully supersede any similar, conflicting, inconsistent or overlapping terms in the IAB Terms or other parts of an IO; however, if an IO expressly states that certain terms set forth in the IO are intended to supersede the terms of this Discord Addendum, then, in the event of conflict, those terms of the applicable IO will control only for that IO and only to the extent of such conflict. Any purchase order terms, “clickthrough” or other online agreements, or other similar documents made available to Media Company by Advertiser or Agency are hereby rejected by Media Company and will not apply to any Quest. Capitalized terms used but not defined herein will have the meanings given to such terms in the IAB Terms. 

Where Advertiser is purchasing directly from Media Company, (i) Section 2 and any references to Agency herein will be deemed deleted and will not apply; and (ii) all references in the IAB Terms to Agency, will be deemed to be references to Advertiser.

1. Quest Terms.

a. Quests. Media Company will implement a promotional campaign on its platform (the “Discord Platform”) for Advertiser’s applicable property designated on an IO (the “Advertiser Property”) where eligible users of the Discord Platform will be able to complete certain agreed-upon tasks relating to the Advertiser Property and earn certain agreed-upon rewards (“Rewards”), as further detailed in an applicable IO (each such campaign, a “Quest”).  

b. Quest T&Cs. Media Company will, in consultation with Advertiser or Agency, as applicable, establish the specific terms and requirements for users governing each Quest (“Quest T&Cs”), and will publish the Quest T&Cs to users in connection with such Quest. The Quest T&Cs will address, at a minimum (i) user eligibility requirements and any criteria and tasks that must be satisfied by a user in order to receive a Reward; (ii) the nature of the applicable Reward, including whether the Reward will be supplied by Media Company (each, a “Media Company Reward”) or Advertiser (each, an “Advertiser Reward”); and (iv) any other terms, conditions and limitations pertaining to the redemption and use of the Reward.  

c. Advertiser Rewards. Unless otherwise indicated on an IO, the Reward will be an Advertiser Reward approved by Media Company and either the Advertiser or Agency, as applicable. For any Quest with an Advertiser Reward: (i) reasonably in advance of the applicable flight dates for a Quest, the parties will agree in writing (email to suffice) on and implement the fulfillment and redemption mechanics for the Advertiser Reward, which may consist of the delivery to Media Company of a sufficient number of redemption codes for users to redeem for Advertiser Rewards; (ii) Advertiser or Agency, as applicable, will ensure that the Advertiser Reward and the redemption process is consistent with the Quest T&Cs; and (iii) in the event of any fulfillment or redemption issues (including, without limitation, insufficient or defective redemption codes) in connection with a Quest, Media Company may suspend such Quest until such issues are resolved.  For clarity, Advertiser is solely responsible for the Advertiser Rewards and any associated fraud, losses, or other issues in connection with such Advertiser Rewards. 

d. Media Company Rewards.  For any Quest where the applicable IO indicates there will be a Media Company Reward, Media Company will (i) ensure that such Media Company Reward and redemption process is consistent with the Quest T&Cs; and (ii) will have responsibility (unless otherwise agreed in the IO) and control over the design and creation of such Media Company Reward. Media Company will obtain Advertiser’s or Agency’s approval (not to be unreasonably withheld) for any Media Company Reward that contains or is derived from Advertising Materials. Media Company Rewards may not be available to users in certain regions where not supported by the Discord Platform. Advertiser and Agency may not terminate for convenience any Quest with (i) a Media Company Reward that contains or is derived from Advertising Materials (“Custom Reward”) or (ii) any other custom Media Company Reward created specifically for the Quest. Where there is a Custom Reward, Advertiser, or Agency on behalf of Advertiser, grants Discord a worldwide, royalty-free, perpetual license in and to the Custom Reward to provide it to Discord Nitro users. 

e. Advertiser Marks License. 

i. Advertiser and Agency hereby grant Media Company a limited, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use and display Advertiser’s name, designated trademarks and associated logos, and any names, trademarks or logos associated with the Advertiser Property (the “Advertiser Marks”) in connection with the implementation of a Quest, the performance of Media Company’s obligations under the Campaign Terms and any IO, or as otherwise approved in writing by Advertiser or Agency. 

ii. All goodwill and improved reputation generated by Media Company’s use of the Advertiser Marks inures to the exclusive benefit of Advertiser. Media Company will use the Advertiser Marks in a manner consistent with any branding guidelines provided by Advertiser to Media Company in writing.

f. Advertising Materials.  Advertiser and Agency hereby grant Media Company a limited, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use, display, adapt, translate, modify, copy, publicly perform, transmit and distribute the Advertising Materials in connection with the implementation or promotion of a Quest, the performance of Media Company’s obligations under the Campaign Terms or as otherwise approved by Advertiser or Agency, as applicable, including, without limitation, in connection with the development, distribution and making available of applicable Media Company Rewards containing or derived from such Advertising Materials. The licenses set forth herein are sublicensable by Media Company to its affiliates, agents, and subcontractors in connection with Media Company performance hereunder (and, with respect to Media Company Rewards containing or derived from Advertising Materials, to end users who claim any such Media Company Rewards in connection with a Quest). Advertiser or Agency, as applicable, will, at its own cost and expense, obtain all necessary licenses, consents, approvals and permissions from any third party required for Media Company to exercise its rights under the foregoing license. For purposes of the Campaign Terms, “Advertising Materials” means any content, materials, copy, branding, images, names, audio, music, video, artwork, designs, descriptions, specifications, and other elements made available by Advertiser or Agency to Media Company for use in connection with a Quest, including, without limitation, any elements, materials, assets or intellectual property from the Advertiser Property. 

g. Cooperation.  Media Company’s ability to implement the Quest and its obligations under the Campaign Terms and any IO (including, without limitation, the ability to meet the applicable timeframes and schedules for a Quest as specified in an IO) will be contingent upon the timely provision of cooperation from Advertiser or Agency, as applicable, in connection with the Quest, which cooperation includes, without limitation, providing any redemption codes, Advertising Materials and/or Advertiser Rewards as required by Media Company with sufficient lead time for the applicable Quest, compliance with applicable Policies or other campaign and asset specifications, and timely feedback, reviews and approvals for any items and matters requiring approval or input in connection with a Quest. Advertiser and Agency will adhere to any Policies and other agreed upon timeframes, campaign specifications, and development schedules in connection with the foregoing. Media Company will not be liable or responsible for any delays or issues caused by Advertiser’s or Agency’s failure or delay in providing such cooperation.

h. Quest Prompts.  Media Company will be responsible for developing, producing, and displaying prompts or notifications promoting the availability of a Quest (“Quest Prompts”) to certain users on applicable surfaces within the Discord Platform. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary, Media Company will have ultimate authority and control over the content, placement, frequency, delivery, timing and accompanying disclosures in connection with all Quest Prompts on the Discord Platform. Media Company reserves the right to suspend or cancel the targeting, personalization, and/or delivery of Quest Prompts in connection with any Quest.  

i. Reporting.  For each Quest, Media Company will provide summary reports to Advertiser or Agency, as applicable, regarding certain estimated performance metrics, insights and KPIs within a reasonable timeframe after the midpoint and end date of such Quest. The information in such reports may be used by Advertiser solely for its own internal business purposes but will otherwise be considered Media Company’s Confidential Information. 

j. Estimates.  Notwithstanding anything to the contrary, any impression or reach numbers, impression-related commitments, targeting parameters, geographies or estimates provided on an IO and any information provided in connection with any report delivered by Media Company with respect to any Quest are provided by Media Company solely on an “AS IS” basis as estimates for informational purposes based on the data reasonably available to Media Company and are not guaranteed or considered binding by the parties in connection with any Quest. Media Company will not be liable (or required to offer any makegood) for any errors, shortfalls, inaccuracies or omissions in connection with any of the foregoing.

2. Agency Authority.  Agency represents, warrants and covenants that it has obtained and will maintain all consents, approvals and authorizations from Advertiser necessary for Agency to (i) bind Advertiser to the Campaign Terms and any IO, act on behalf of Advertiser and otherwise comply with its obligations in connection with the Campaign Terms and any IO, including, without limitation, with respect to (a) the execution of any IOs on Advertiser’s behalf, (b) the ability to pay Media Company for any Quest; (c) the ability to share Advertiser’s Confidential Information with Media Company; and (c) the management and provision of any and all approvals, feedback and reviews in connection with the Campaign Terms and any IO (e.g., the review and approval of Rewards and other Quest elements, press releases, promotional materials, or creative assets); and (ii) grant the licenses set forth in the Campaign Terms and any IO, including, without limitation, any such licenses to Advertiser Marks and Advertising Materials set forth herein. Media Company will be entitled to rely on any documents executed, instructions provided or approvals granted by Agency on an Advertiser’s behalf in connection with the Campaign Terms and any IO. Agency will indemnify and hold Media Company harmless from and against any losses or unpaid obligations under any IOs arising from Agency’s violation of this Section. 

3. Taxes. Unless otherwise stated in an IO, Media Company’s fees do not include any direct or indirect local, state, federal or foreign taxes, levies, duties or similar governmental assessments of any nature, including value-added, use, sales or withholding taxes collected by any jurisdiction. Each party is responsible for all of its own business taxes (including, but not limited to, net income, gross receipts, franchise, or other similar business taxes) arising as a result of or in connection with any IO. Advertiser or Agency, as applicable, is responsible for self-assessing any transaction taxes (e.g. sales tax, VAT, GST or similar taxes) due with respect to any IO. Media Company will collect, and Advertiser or Agency, as applicable, will pay any applicable transaction taxes if Media Company determines that it has a duty to collect such taxes. Advertiser or Agency, as applicable, is responsible for any transaction taxes on user rewards redeemed outside of the Discord Platform. For transaction tax purposes, Quests will be treated as services related to promotional advertising campaigns. To the extent withholding tax is required by applicable law, Advertiser or Agency, as applicable, will be responsible for collecting and remitting such taxes to the appropriate tax authorities. Additionally, Advertiser or Agency, as applicable, will provide Media Company an original receipt or documentation from the tax authority for the withholding tax payments.

4. Amendments to IAB Terms. 

a. General Acknowledgements.  The parties acknowledge and agree that: (i) Quests are treated as flat-fee based Deliverables delivered on the Discord Platform for purposes of the IAB Terms; (ii) the terms of the IAB Terms relating to inventory availability, delivery schedule, ad placement and positioning, use of collected data, and reporting will be superseded and governed by the applicable terms of Section 1 of this Discord Addendum and any IO; and (iii) Quests do not use or involve any Third Party Ad Server and any associated terms in the IAB Terms do not apply.

b. Specific Amendments. 

i. Section X(b) of the IAB Terms is hereby amended to add the following new subclauses (iv) and (v):

“(iv) allegations that the Advertising Materials or Advertiser Marks infringe, misappropriate or otherwise violate any intellectual property rights of a third party; or (v) Advertiser Rewards, including, without limitation, any claims from users that Advertiser Rewards were misleading or inaccurate or that they were not properly fulfilled.”

ii. Section XI of the IAB Terms is hereby amended and restated as follows:

“Excluding Agency’s, Advertiser’s, and Media Company’s respective indemnification obligations under the Campaign Terms, damages that result from a breach of Section XII, or intentional misconduct by Agency, Advertiser, or Media Company, in no event will any party be liable (i) for any consequential, indirect, incidental, punitive, special, or exemplary damages whatsoever or any damages for loss of profits, business interruption, loss of information, and the like, incurred by another party arising out of an IO, even if such party has been advised of the possibility of such damages; or (ii) in the aggregate in connection with these Campaign Terms or the IO in excess of the amount paid or payable by Agency or Advertiser to Media Company hereunder.”

iii. For purposes of Section XIV(d) of the IAB Terms, the choice of law governing any IO will be the State of New York without reference to its choice of law rules, and all claims, legal proceedings or litigations arising in connection with the Campaign Terms will be brought solely in state and federal courts located in New York City.

iv. Section XIV.e of the IAB Terms is hereby amended and restated as follows:

“All notices of termination or breach must be in English, in writing and addressed to the other party’s legal department (with a copy to any contact listed on an IO). The email address for notices being sent to the Media Company legal department is legal.notices@discordapp.com. All other notices must be in English, in writing (including email) and addressed to the other party’s applicable notice information designated on an IO. Notice will be treated as given on receipt, as verified by written or automated receipt or by electronic log (as applicable).”
