name: How to Request a Refund from Discord
title: How to Request a Refund from Discord
body:
You can request a refund for your Discord subscription if it meets our Refund Policy requirements. Simply find your payment ID and submit your request to the Discord Billing Support Team.

What this article covers:
  • How to Find your Payment ID
    • Desktop/Browser
    • Mobile
  • How to Request a Refund
NOTE: Before requesting a refund, check out our Refund Policy to ensure your purchase is eligible.

How to Find your Payment ID

NOTE: You can only locate your payment ID within the desktop app or browser.

Before submitting a request for a refund, you’ll need to make sure you have the payment ID for the purchase that you’d like refunded. This helps us process your request quickly and ensure we refund the correct purchase.

Desktop/Browser

1. Head into your User Settings by pressing the cogwheel [] icon.

 

Cogwheel Icon on Desktop/Browser

2. Tap Billing, then select  the purchase for which you need the  payment ID.

3. The payment ID will appear in the dropdown menu. You can copy this ID and paste it into the support form.

Example of a Payment ID in the Billing tab of Discord’s User Settings

Mobile

NOTE: For any purchases (besides a Server Subscription) made on Discord using your iOS device, you will need to request a refund for those purchases via the iOS App Store. If you’re wanting to request a refund for a Server Subscription purchase, you can follow the steps below to obtain a payment ID.

In order to get your payment ID for a mobile purchase, please refer to the confirmation email you received with your purchase. This will include the payment ID.

For Android users, you can provide a payment ID, however, another option that provides a quicker turnaround is your GPA number from your Google Play Store confirmation email. If you’re unable to find your confirmation email from Google Play, you can check out their guide here on how to locate the GPA number.

If you can’t locate your confirmation email, you can obtain your payment ID through the desktop app or browser by following the steps above.

Confirmation email showing the Payment ID after making a purchase

How to Request a Refund

NOTE: Make sure when filling out the form you’re providing the email address that is tied to your Discord account.

1. Once you have your Payment ID, head to the Support form. 

2. Fill out each question in the form as it pertains to your billing request. Make sure to enter the Payment ID where requested.

3. After submitting your request you should receive a confirmation email letting you know your ticket has been received.

4. You will receive a response from the team once your ticket has been handled. 

NOTE: For any questions about refunds or billing matters, please contact the Discord Support team

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How can I request a refund for my Discord subscription?

A: You can request a refund by finding your payment ID and submitting a request to the Discord Billing Support Team. Make sure your request meets the Refund Policy requirements.

Q: What do I need before requesting a refund?

A: You need to:

  • Review the Discord Refund Policy to ensure your purchase is eligible
  • Have your payment ID ready
  • Use the email address associated with your Discord account

Q: How do I find my payment ID on desktop/browser?

1. Open User Settings via the cogwheel icon

2. Go to Billing and select the relevant purchase

3. Find the payment ID in the dropdown menu

Q: What if I made purchases on iOS or Android?

A: To request a refund from Apple, you will need to request a refund for those purchases via the iOS App Store.

 Android users need to provide the GPA number from their Google Play Store confirmation email instead of a payment ID. If you’re unable to find your confirmation email from Google Play, you can check out their guide here on how to locate the GPA number.

Q: What happens after I submit my refund request?

A: You'll receive:

  • An immediate confirmation email of your ticket submitted to our Support team
  • A response once your ticket has been processed

Q: What if I can’t find my payment ID?

A: If you can’t locate your payment ID in the Billing tab, you can obtain it from the confirmation email. If you still can’t locate it, please submit a request to the Discord Support team under the email address tied to your Discord account.

name: How to Ignore Users on Discord
title: How to Ignore Users on Discord
body:
Discover how to use Discord's Ignore feature - a helpful tool that lets you make space from specific users without fully blocking them or letting them know. With Ignore, you can hide new messages, DM and server message notifications, profiles, and activities from those specific users, giving you more control over your experience on Discord. This article explains how to ignore users and how to manage ignored users.

What this article covers:
  • What is the Ignore Feature?
  • How to Ignore a User
    • When Viewing a User’s Profile 
    • In Safety Tools and Safety Alerts
    • After Submitting a Report
    • In a Direct Message
  • Managing Your Ignore List
    • Desktop/Browser
    • Mobile
  • How to Un-Ignore a User
  • Frequently Asked Questions

What is the Ignore Feature?

In addition to Blocking and Muting, Discord also lets users ignore specific users.

When ignoring a user, here's what happens:

  • When a user is ignored, their direct messages (DM) appear darkened. You'll also see the Ignore [] icon next to their messages.

DM with an Ignore Icon 

  • Their messages will be hidden in DMs, group chats, and servers. If you want to view these ignored messages, simply press the Show button.

Show Button For Ignored Message

  • Before viewing an ignored user's profile, you'll see a warning screen. Their profile will display their ignored status.

 

Warning Screens: Ignored User's Profile (Left) and Profile Ignore Status (Right)

  • If you attempt to join a voice or video call that includes someone you've ignored, you'll receive a warning before connecting.

Example of Voice or Video Warning

How to Ignore a User

There are a few different places to find this setting for each user. You will see the Ignore option when:

When Viewing a User’s Profile 

  1. To ignore a specific user, right-click the user’s avatar to open the drop-down menu. 
  2. Select the Ignore option.
  3. After making your selection, press Ignore in the confirmation pop-up window.

How to Ignore a User While Viewing a User’s Profile on Desktop

To ignore a user on mobile, tap their avatar, then tap the ellipsis [] in the upper-right corner > Ignore.

 

How to Ignore a User While Viewing a User’s Profile on Mobile

In Safety Tools and Safety Alerts

Safety tools and Safety Alerts warn teen users when we detect potentially inappropriate messages. Teens can choose to select the Ignore option when these tools and alerts appear.

 

Safety Tools Ignore Option: Desktop (Left) vs. Mobile (Right)

After Submitting a Report

To ignore a user, right-click the message you would like to report and press Report Message. After submitting a report, you will be able to select the Ignore option in the More you can do menu.     

 

Message Reporting: Right-Click Menu (Left) and Ignore Option in "More You Can Do" Menu (Right)

On mobile, long press the message you would like to report and tap Report. After the report has been submitted, you will be able to ignore the user.

After Report Submission: Mobile Ignore Option

In a Direct Message

1. To ignore a specific user in a DM, right-click the user’s avatar to open the drop-down menu. 

2. Select the Ignore option. 

3. After making your selection, press Ignore in the confirmation pop-up window.

How to Ignore a User in DMs on Desktop

On mobile, tap the user in DMs, then select the ellipsis [] > Ignore and confirm your choice. 

How to Ignore a User in DMs on Mobile

Managing the Accounts You’ve Ignored 

Desktop/Browser

To manage the accounts you’ve ignored on desktop or browser, you can view your list at any time by going to your User Settings [] > Content & Social. There you'll find the Accounts you've blocked & ignored list.  

Content & Social on Desktop: Accounts You’ve Blocked & Ignored List

Mobile

1. On mobile, you can view your list of ignored users by tapping your avatar in the bottom-right corner. 

Avatar Icon on Mobile

2. Then, tap the cogwheel [] in the upper-right corner to navigate to Settings > Content & Social.

3. There you can scroll down to the Accounts you've blocked & ignored list where you can tap Ignored accounts.  

Content & Social on Mobile: Accounts You’ve Blocked & Ignored List

How to Un-Ignore a User

You can un-ignore a user at any time. Here are three ways to do this on desktop or browser: 

1. Un-Ignore from Friend List: Right-clicking the ignored user in your Friends List, then select Unignore.

Un-ignoring a User in the Friends List

2. Un-Ignore from Profile: Select the ellipsis [] and press Unignore or use the Unignore button next to the You ignored them notice.

Unignore Options in a User’s Profile

3. Un-Ignore in Content & Social: Go to User Settings > Content & Social. Then scroll to the Accounts you've blocked & ignored list and select Unignore next to the specific user you would like to un-ignore.  

Un-ignoring a User in Content & Social

On mobile, tap the user's avatar, then select the ellipsis [] > Unignore. Alternatively, go to Settings > Content & Social > Accounts you've blocked or ignored, then tap Unignore in the Ignored accounts list. 

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Will the user know that I ignored them?

A: No, they will not be able to visually detect in their Discord experience that you have ignored their account. 

Q: Can ignored users still see my messages?

A: Yes, they can still view your messages and profile. They will not be able to visually detect in their Discord experience that you have ignored their account. 

Q: What's the difference between blocking and ignoring?

A: What Happens When You Ignore Someone:

Feature Your Experience The Ignored User’s Experience
Direct Messages You can still send them direct messages. Their messages to you will be hidden without notifications. They can still message you (but you won’t get notifications).
Messages in shared spaces You can still tag or reply to their messages. Their messages to you will be hidden without notifications. They can still message, tag, and interact with you (but you won’t get notifications).
Profile Visibility Their profile is hidden unless you choose to unhide it. They can see your full profile.
Activity Visibility Limited activity visibility; some group activity may still show. They can see your online presence and activity.
Friendship Status Friends are not removed; if you are not friends, their friend requests go to the friend request inbox without alerts. They remain your friend, or non-friends can still send new friend requests.

What Happens When You Block Someone:

Feature Your Experience The Blocked User’s Experience
Direct Messages You cannot send messages to a blocked user. They cannot message you
Messages in shared spaces You can still tag or reply to their messages. Their messages to you will be hidden without notifications. They can still message, tag, and interact with you (but you won’t get notifications).
Profile Visibility Their profile is hidden unless you choose to unhide it. They see a limited version of your profile.
Activity Visibility Limited activity visibility; some group activity may still show. Limited activity visibility; some group activity may still show.
Friendship Status Friendship is removed, and they cannot send new friend requests. They are unfriended and see an error when trying to re-add you.

name: In-game Features Powered by Discord FAQ
title: In-game Features Powered by Discord FAQ
body:
Discord has launched an integration for game developers to power various social and communication features within their games. For you, it means some aspects of your in-game experience (such as in-game voice or friends lists) will be powered by Discord.

This means you can enjoy everything you love about Discord directly in your game, even without a Discord account. Connect and play with friends through seamless cross-platform messaging, voice chat, and other powerful features. It’s never been easier to keep the party going—whether you’re actively playing or just hanging out.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Does that mean I need a registered Discord account to play the game?

A: Players will not be required to connect a registered Discord account to play games that integrate Discord-powered social features.

Q: Can I exchange messages with my friends on Discord while playing this game?

A: Yes, in some games, players are able to exchange messages with friends across Discord while they’re in-game, even if their friends aren’t playing in the same game.

Q: Will this integration impact my game performance?

A: These integrations are designed to avoid impacting game performance.

Q: Am I required to use the in-game features that enable me to send/receive Discord messages and view my Discord friends from within a game?

A: No, the social features that enable you to send/receive Discord messages and view your Discord friends from within a game are optional. You can choose whether to use them.

Q: Do I need to connect my Discord account to view my Discord friends on my in-game friends list? 

A: Yes. If you want to view your Discord friends on your in-game friends list, you will need to connect your Discord account.

Q: Do I need to connect my Discord account to be able to send or receive messages in the game?

A: You can use the game’s messaging features without connecting your Discord account. In-game communication functions, such as direct messages with friends, can work without the need for a connected Discord account.

If you choose to connect your Discord account, you'll gain the added convenience of sending and receiving some of those same in-game messages on Discord. The connection simply extends where you can access your conversations – your friends can continue chatting with you in-game even if they haven't connected their own Discord accounts.

Q: What will the game developer be able to do with my Discord messages?

A: Before connecting your Discord account, you'll see a clear permissions screen outlining the data that you’re authorizing the game to receive from your Discord account. Developers are only permitted to use this data to power the integration, which includes accessing messages that appear in their game for moderation purposes.  

For more information about the developer’s data practices, please review the developer’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. You can review and revoke your account connection at any time through your Discord Connections tab within the User Settings.

Q: What will Discord do with my messages from the game that appear in Discord?

A: Messages sent from the game that appear on Discord are treated like any other message on Discord consistent with Discord's Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. 

Q: Which messages from the game will be synced with Discord?

A: Direct Messages with a Discord user or in-game friends will be shown in Discord. 

Lobby text messages will not be in Discord, unless that lobby is linked to a Discord channel. 

Messages in Linked Channels will be displayed in Discord, regardless of whether an account is linked.

Q: If I'm messaging someone on Discord, how can I tell when they’re messaging me from within a game?

A: When a user has sent a message from within a game, a controller icon will appear next to their name as a visual indicator.

Q: How can I tell when I’m sending messages in a Linked Channel? 

A: There are a few visual indicators that you are viewing a Linked Channel while on Discord. You will see a controller icon at the top right corner of the channel symbol. You will also see the title of the game that’s linked. 

In the desktop app, it will be next to the channel name in the header; in the mobile app, it will be in the channel profile. In addition, a system message will be sent in the channel notifying members that the channel has been linked to a game.

NOTE: If you’re running into an issue connecting your Discord account to your game, please reach out to the game developer for further assistance. Discord Support is not able to assist with in-game connection of accounts.

      • How to Leave a Leaderboard
      • How to Customize Your Server’s Leaderboard

What Are Leaderboards?

Note: This is currently an experimental feature and is only available to a limited number of League of Legends players on desktop (Windows and Mac OS) and browser.

Leaderboards allow users to share their stats for a game, activity or application, and compete against other members in a server.

Leaderboards via the Desktop App

How to View Leaderboards

For servers in the experiment, a Leaderboard will appear on the Recent Activity section of the Member List. 

League of Legends Displayed as Activity Status in Members List

By hovering over the League of Legends activity in the Members List, you can view the Leaderboard for the server and see where everyone ranks.

Selecting a User in the Leaderboard

How to Join Leaderboards

In order to join Leaderboards, you will need to connect your League of Legends account to your Discord account. If you haven’t connected your League of Legends account already, there are two ways to do this.

Connecting Through the Leaderboard

1. With the Leaderboard opened, tap on Join Leaderboard at the bottom and then follow the prompts to connect your League of Legends account to Discord.

“Join Leaderboard” Button in the Leaderboard

Connecting in User Settings

1. Press on the cogwheel [] in the bottom-left corner to access your User Settings .

2. Select Connections and then choose League of Legends to connect your account.

Connections Tab within User Settings

3. After following the prompts, your League of Legends account will be connected to your Discord account. You can learn more about Connections through the Connections & Linked Roles: Community Members Help Center article. 

How Leaderboard Competition Works

Here's everything you need to know to participate and track your progress:

Viewing the Leaderboard
  • Find the leaderboard in the Recent Activity section of the server's members list.
  • Leaderboards are based on various League of Legends stats, including:
    • Wins
    • Kills
    • Damage taken
  • We may introduce additional stats in future updates.
Rank Updates
  • Your stats and rank updates automatically within 30 minutes after each match.
  • Discord fetches your latest match stats to keep the leaderboard current.
Rewards and Recognition
  • The #1 ranked player receives a special icon next to their name in the server.
  • Leaderboards reset weekly, giving everyone a fresh chance to compete.
Sharing Your Achievements
  • Want to showcase your rank? Simply copy a player's rank from the leaderboard.
  • Paste the rank in any text channel to share with the community.

Example of a User’s Ranking

Leaderboard Controls

How to Leave a Leaderboard

You can remove yourself from a server’s leaderboard by tapping on the ellipsis [] and  selecting Leave Leaderboard.

“Leave Leaderboard” Button

How to Customize Your Server’s Leaderboard

Members with the Manage Server permissions enabled can customize how the Leaderboard behaves in the server. 

Manager Server Permission 

1. With the Leaderboard opened, tap on the ellipsis [] and then select Manage Settings. 

Manage Settings Option in Leaderboards

2. There are two ways to customize the leaderboard:

  • Select a different stat as the basis for competition (e.g., kills, deaths, assists, damage taken or dealt, and wins).
  • Disable the role icon in chat.

Leaderboard Settings

name: HD Splash Potion FAQ
title: HD Splash Potion FAQ
body:
HD Splash Potion allows everyone in a voice channel to enjoy HD video streaming quality for the next 12 hours without Nitro and Server Boosts.

What this article covers:
  • What is the HD Splash Potion?
  • Why and when should I use an HD Splash Potion?
  • How do I activate and use my HD Splash Potion?
  • Frequently Asked Questions
HD Splash Potions are currently an experimental feature, available only to select desktop users.

What is the HD Splash Potion?

Why, adventurer, you may have stumbled into a curious, new trinket on Discord…

The HD Splash Potion is a new feature that grants the magical properties of crystal-clear HD streaming quality on Discord.

With a single use, you and everyone in a designated voice channel can enjoy crystal-clear HD streaming quality for the next 12 hours - without anyone needing an active Nitro subscription or Server Boosts.

Example of Using an HD Splash Potion 

NOTE: Potion availability and streaming quality may be impacted by the device conditions of participants in the channel.

Why and when should I use the HD Splash Potion?

The HD Splash Potion is perfect for any moment where you and your friends want to enjoy crystal-clear HD streaming quality together at the same time, even when you don’t have server boosts or an active Nitro subscription.

Whether you’re gaming together, hosting a watch-and-hangout session, or studying with others, some examples of popular situations to sip your HD Splash potion could include:

  • Group gaming sessions
  • Watch parties
  • Group gatherings and hangouts
  • Community events like music, art, and talent shows
  • Study sessions and presentations

How do I activate and use my HD Splash Potion?

You and your friends can enjoy enhanced streaming quality by following these steps:
1. In a voice channel, select the Screen Share [] icon.

Share Your Screen Button in Voice Channel

2. In the Screen Share pop out, locate and select your HD Splash Potion. This channel will become your designated space where your entire squad can enjoy streaming in HD quality together.
Choose a voice channel carefully. The potion’s HD splash effect can’t be moved to a different channel once after it’s activated.

Selecting the HD Splash Potion in Screen Share Menu

3. Once you’re certain of the voice channel, be sure to confirm.

HD Splash Potion Voice Channel Selection and Confirmation: Your first HD Splash Potion is free on us! Afterwards, you can purchase more potions as needed. 

And that’s it! You’ll know you and your squad are enjoying HD streaming quality once you see the HD tag over your streams.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What platforms is the HD Splash Potion available on?

A: Currently, it’s only available on desktop devices.

Q: How much do HD Splash Potions cost?

A: Your first HD Splash Potion is free so you can try it out to see if you like it. After using your free potion, additional HD Splash Potions can be purchased for $0.99 USD each.

Q: Do I need Nitro or server boosts to use an HD Splash Potion?

A: Nope! The HD Splash Potion grants HD streaming quality in a designated channel for a set period of time—for you, your friends, and other server members who have access to that voice channel. No Nitro or server boosts required!

Q: How long does the HD Splash Potion last?

A: Once used, the HD Splash Potion will grant 12 hours of HD streaming quality in the channel where it was activated. Anyone who joins the designated channel will enjoy HD streaming until the potion’s effect expires.

You can still control your streaming quality at any time. For instance, if you notice your device’s performance struggling, you can adjust the streaming quality in the Share Your Screen pop out.

Q: Does everyone in the channel need to have or use a HD Splash Potion to enjoy HD streaming quality?

A: Nope! Just one person needs to use their potion in a designated channel to grant everyone in that channel the ability to benefit from HD streaming quality.

Q: Do I need to be friends with the potion user to receive HD streaming from the potion?

A: Not at all! Once someone uses their HD Splash potion in a channel, anyone can enjoy HD streaming quality in that designated channel, regardless of friendship status.

Q: What happens when the 12 hours are up?

A: Once the time is up, HD streaming quality in the designated channel will return to its standard quality for anyone without an active Nitro subscription.

Q: Can I move the HD Splash effect from my potion to a different channel after I’ve activated it in one channel?

A: Nope. The HD Splash potion will only grant its effect in the channel where it was used. Choose the voice channel carefully before activating the potion.

Q: What’s your refund policy for the HD Splash Potion?

A: Potions are non-refundable—we’re unable to refund potions after purchase or use.

Q: What happens if a person with low bandwidth is watching my HD Splash Potion stream?

A: The effect of the HD Splash Potion can be impacted by the technical limitations of your or your fellow streamers' device or bandwidth. HD streaming capability may be limited if people watching your stream have low bandwidth or are tuning in from an unsupported device. To ensure that everyone in the call can benefit from the HD Splash Potion, make sure everyone in the call has a strong internet connection and is watching from a desktop device.

name: My Discord Email was Changed and I Want to Undo It
title: My Discord Email was Changed and I Want to Undo It
body:
What this article covers:
  • How to Undo an Email Address Change
  • I Got an Error When Trying to Undo My Email Change
  • How Does the Account Recovery Link Actually Work?
Note: Please note that account recovery links will become invalid after a 48 hour time period. Do not share this link to others.

Changing the email on your Discord account is a big deal! That’s why we send you an extra email notification to the original email address after it’s been confirmed. 

This message also includes a button to let you revert or undo the email change within 48 hours, as an extra method to keep you in control of your account.

How to Undo an Email Address Change

Note: The URL will always start with https://discord.com/wasntme/ - anything else is fake and not from Discord!

1. To start, press the button in the email notification we sent you that says Start Account Recovery. 

This link is uniquely generated for your account and is only valid for 48 hours - don’t share it with anyone!

2. After tapping the link, you’ll be taken to an Account Recovery page where you will be able to complete the following:

  • Change your Discord account’s email back to the previous email address
  • Log out the Discord account from all devices
  • Update your password
  • Remove any phone number on the Discord account
  • Remove any Multi-Factor Authentication methods on the Discord account
  • Invalidate existing recovery URLs for email changes to your account made after this one

3. To complete the process, follow the instructions after pressing Start revert process. 

You’ll provide a new password, and then the email address for your Discord account will be reverted to the one we sent the recovery link to - alongside the other changes listed on the page.

Note: If you had a phone number or MFA device enrolled on the account, be sure to add those back after completing the recovery process! For more details, check out the Setting up Multi-Factor Authentication Help Center article.

I Got an Error When Trying to Undo My Email Change

For technical reasons, you’ll only see an error when trying to complete the password reset part of this process, and not before that. 

Common reasons you could see an error here are:

  • It’s been more than 48 hours since we sent you the recovery link, and it’s no longer valid.
  • A recovery has already been performed on this account using a link we sent before the one being used.
  • The email address that the link was sent to is currently in use by another Discord account. To complete the account recovery, ensure that no other Discord accounts are using that email address.
  • The password you’re attempting to set is invalid. For example, we don’t accept passwords less than 8 characters, and some regions may have additional password requirements

Note: If your account recovery link has expired, the Discord support team is not able to send you a new one.

How Does the Account Recovery Link Work?

To ensure the security of the account (and prevent scammers from regaining access to the account after you perform the recovery), the following restrictions are in place for the recovery process:

  • The link is only valid for 48 hours.
  • If multiple recovery links have been generated for an account, using one will invalidate any that were created after the one that was used.
  • Any phone number and MFA devices associated with the account are removed.
  • You are required to change your password during this process (in case someone knows your current password), and the Discord account will be logged out from all devices.
Note: If you’d like to learn more information about compromised or hacked accounts and how to report abusive behavior on Discord, please review our My Discord Account was Hacked or Compromised Help Center article.

name: How to Cancel your Server Subscription
title: How to Cancel your Server Subscription
body:
Note: If you’re looking to cancel a different subscription. Please check out the corresponding article: Nitro subscription, Server subscription, or Premium App.
What this article covers:
  • How to Cancel Server Subscription on Desktop/Browser
  • How to Cancel Server Subscription on Mobile
  • How Do I Re-Subscribe After Canceling My Subscription?
  • What if I Can’t Access My Discord and Need to Cancel?

Note: If you want to request a refund for your subscription instead, please check out the Refund Policy Help Center article.

You can cancel your Server subscription at any time. Once canceled, your subscription will end at the end of your current billing period. 

Note: Subscriptions need to be canceled on the same device type where the purchase was originally made.

For example:
If you purchased a Server Subscription through the desktop or browser app, you must cancel it through the desktop app or browser.

If you purchased through a mobile device, you can only cancel through a mobile device. If you don’t have access to your device to cancel yourself, please check out this section.

How to Cancel Server Subscription on Desktop/Browser

1. Tap on the cogwheel [] next to your Discord username to access your User Settings.

2. Then head to the Subscriptions tab.

3. Here you should see a banner for your Server Subscriptions. To cancel, tap on Manage Memberships.

4. Here you will see all of your current Server Subscriptions.

To cancel, tap on the dropdown next to the Server Subscription you want to cancel and then tap on Cancel my Membership.

5. Follow the prompts to fully cancel your Server Subscription.

How to Cancel Server Subscription on Mobile

1. Tap on your avatar in the bottom right.

2. Then, tap on the cogwheel [] in the top right.

3. Next, scroll down to Billing Settings and tap on Manage Nitro. If you don’t have an active Nitro subscription, you’ll need to tap on Get Nitro at the top instead.

4. Here you should see all of your current subscriptions. Next to your Server subscription, tap on Cancel.

5. Now just follow the on-screen device prompts to cancel your subscription.

Once the cancellation has been completed, your Manage Nitro settings will show the date on which your subscription will expire and you will lose your subscription benefits.

Alternatively, you can also cancel your Discord subscriptions directly on your mobile device settings by following these instructions for Apple iOS subscriptions or Google Play subscriptions.

How Do I Re-Subscribe After Canceling My Subscription?

Note: If you’re trying to re-subscribe on your mobile device, the steps might be a little different. Please head to the Manage Nitro tab under your User Settings in order to re-subscribe your subscription.

If you’ve changed your mind and no longer wish for your Server subscription to end at the end of your billing period, then you can always reactivate it. Just make sure you do before the billing period ends, otherwise you’ll just have to purchase a new subscription. Here’s how to re-subscribe:

1. Tap on cogwheel [] next to your Discord username to access your User Settings.

2. Next, navigate to the Subscriptions tab.

3. Now, tap on Re-Subscribe within the corresponding banner to uncancel your subscription. 

You’ll be able to tell it was reactivated, because you’ll see the banner no longer has Pending Cancellation listed.

What if I Can’t Access my Discord and Need to Cancel?

Note: If your Discord purchase was through an Apple device, please reach out to Apple to cancel your subscription. The Discord Support team is not able to manage your iOS subscription.

If you’re unable to log into your Discord account for any reason and cancel your subscription (for desktop, browser, or even through an Android device) yourself, you can reach out to our Billing Support team under the email address tied to your Discord account and request it to be canceled through here: http://dis.gd/billing. 

If you want to submit a refund request instead, and your purchase is within our Refund Policy, please follow the steps outlined here.

Note: If you want to cancel your subscription, but you are unsure of which subscription type you have, please check out the How to Cancel Your Discord Subscription Help Center article.

name: How to Fix Phone Errors on Discord
title: How to Fix Phone Errors on Discord
body:
What this article covers:
  • Phone is Already Registered
  • Invalid Phone Number
  • Other Phone Errors

There are some error messages that you might notice when trying to register with, add, or change the phone number on your account. Let’s go over those cases and what to do if you’re experiencing those specific errors.

Before you begin the process of adding a phone number, please make sure you have access to that number and your mobile device.

Phone is Already Registered

A phone can only be registered with one Discord account at a time. If you are encountering an error that states This phone number is unable to be associated with this account, this is because the phone number is already tied to another account. As you can only have one number per account, you would need to remove the number from the other account Discord in order to use it.

Note: If you’re unable to remove the phone number yourself, please check out the How to Remove a Phone Number Help Center article for steps.

Invalid Phone Number

Make sure that the phone number you are entering is properly formatted and is valid according to your country’s numbering plan. 

Also, make sure the phone number is not associated with a landline or VOIP device, and that the number you are trying to use is associated with a mobile device.

Other Errors

If you’re running into any other error messages, or you’re receiving one of the errors above and it’s still not working, please reach out to our Support team for further assistance: https://dis.gd/contact

name: Chargebacks FAQ
title: Chargebacks FAQ
body:
Fraudulently issuing chargebacks for purchases made on Discord violates our Terms of Service.

We may suspend accounts following a chargeback being filed to protect your account, our community, or our payment systems from potential abuse or fraud.

To avoid violating this policy, all refund or billing inquiry requests should be directed to our support team at dis.gd/billing instead.⁠⁠

However, if your account has been suspended for this violation, you may appeal the suspension by submitting an appeal to Discord's Trust & Safety Team at dis.gd/request.

What this article covers:
  • What is a Chargeback
  • What This Policy States
  • How to Avoid Violating This Policy
  • How to Appeal a Chargeback Ban on Your Account

What is a Chargeback

A chargeback occurs when a transaction is reported to a payment issuer as incorrect or unrecognized.

Filing a chargeback against a transaction made on Discord may result in account suspension pending further investigation on our end. This suspension is in line with Discord’s Terms of Service which prohibits actions that may cause harm to Discord and others.

This policy aims to maintain a safe and secure environment for our community while preventing potential abuse or fraud through our payment systems.

What This Policy States

Don’t use the services to do harm to Discord. 

Among other things, this includes trying to gain access to or attacking our systems, scraping our services without our written consent, transmitting viruses or other malicious code to our services, abusing or defrauding us or our payment systems, copying our product or using our intellectual property without permission, and misusing our reporting or customer service mechanisms.

How to Avoid Violating This Policy

We take violations of this policy seriously due to the potential harm they may cause to Discord and others. Discord's right to terminate an account following such a violation is stated in our Terms of Service. 

If you require a refund due to a payment issue or unrecognized activity, or if you have any billing questions, please contact our support team at dis.gd/billing. Our team will assist you according to our policies and guidelines.

How to Appeal a Chargeback Ban on Your Account

We value transparency and are committed to protecting Discord and others from harm. If your account has been suspended due to a violation of this policy, you can appeal the enforcement action taken through our support form.

On the form, select “Appeal an action taken on my account or bot” from the “How can we help?” dropdown menu.

In the “What would you like to appeal?” section, select “An action taken on my account”.

To assist with our investigation, please provide the following information in your appeal:

  • The reason the chargeback was filed
  • If applicable, evidence of chargeback claim withdrawal
  • Screenshot of the disputed transaction on your billing statement.
    • Please ensure the screenshot displays the amount and date of transaction along with the descriptor.
Important:
  • We do not accept Discord receipts as proof as payment and this screenshot must be directly from the payment source.
  • Please note that all data associated with accounts suspended for chargebacks is deleted or anonymized 90 days after the suspension process begins.
  • If you submit your appeal after this 90-day period, we will no longer have any record of the account's existence and, consequently, will be unable to process your appeal.

What this article covers:

  • Frequently Asked Questions

iOS Purchases on Discord

When making most purchases on Discord via iOS, there are a few important considerations to keep in mind.
Most Discord subscriptions bought through iOS (such as a Nitro, Nitro gifting, or Server Boost) or the Apple App Store are linked to your Apple ID. This is similar to how purchases work with the Google Play Store. Here's what you need to know:

  • The Discord account used for the first-time purchase of a subscription will link to the Apple ID used for the purchase.
  • Future iOS subscriptions will automatically apply to that same Discord account.
  • You cannot purchase or manage multiple subscriptions for two different Discord accounts through iOS.

If you want to purchase a Discord subscription on iOS for a different account than the one linked to your Apple account, there are a few options:

  • Try using a different device or Discord platform, such as the desktop app, to purchase the subscription on the secondary Discord account. 
  • If you're not using your original Discord account, you can cancel the subscription tied to it and delete the account. Once both steps are complete, you will be able to use your Apple ID on the new account. Please note: the account deletion process will take up to 15 days to complete. '
Note: Discord is unable to assist with Apple subscription issues. Discord subscriptions purchased through the Apple App Store can only be managed in your Apple settings. Users can't manage these subscriptions via desktop, browser, or Android.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How do I know if my subscription is managed through Apple? 

A: To check if Apple manages your Discord subscription on your iOS device, follow the steps on Apple's official website: https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/view-or-cancel-subscriptions-iph4e3e7324f/ios. 

To review your subscription on Discord, head into to your User Settings in the desktop/browser Discord app by selecting the cogwheel icon [] in the bottom-right corner of the app. Once there, navigate to Subscriptions where you will find you are able to review your subscription details. 

Example of Apple managed subscription within Discord

Q: What should I do if my Discord purchase made via iOS is marked as Past Due?

A: If your Discord purchase made via iOS is marked as Past Due, try these steps:

  • Verify that the billing address for the charged card is up-to-date and matches your bank's information.
  • Double-check that your card details are entered correctly.
  • Make sure the card hasn't expired.
  • Ensure there are sufficient funds in the account or that you haven't exceeded the credit limit.
  • Check if you've reached a pre-set spending limit on the card.

If you're still having trouble processing your subscription renewal after trying these steps, contact Apple's Support team. Visit the Apple Support page and log in with the Apple ID you used for the purchase.

Q: I purchased a subscription (Nitro, Server Boosts, etc.) on my Apple device and would like a refund. What should I do?

A: We are unable to process refunds for Discord purchases through iOS, including Nitro, Nitro Classic, Nitro Basic, gift subscriptions, and premium apps. For further assistance, please contact Apple Support by visiting https://reportaproblem.apple.com and logging in with the Apple ID used to make your purchase(s). For more information about both refund policies, please see Discord’s refund policy, and Apple’s refund policy. 

Q: I made a Server Subscription purchase via iOS and would like a refund. What should I do? 

A: Discord’s support team can help refund a Server Subscription purchase if the request was made within 5 days from your initial purchase date. Additionally, Server Subscription refunds are a one-time only exception. To submit a refund request, head over to dis.gd/support to submit a ticket.  

Q: My friend gave me a gift credit, but I have an active subscription managed through iOS. What should I do?

A: Please be aware that gift credits cannot be redeemed on mobile devices. 

To use the gift credit, you will need to cancel your current subscription through your Apple device. Note that subscriptions do not end immediately; they will terminate at the end of the current billing period. Once your subscription has ended, you can redeem your gift credit by subscribing to a matching subscription using the web or desktop client. 

Q: I purchased a Nitro subscription and it's not appearing or working. What should I do?

A: If you purchased a subscription directly from the Apple App Store via your Apple device, the purchase should appear under the Discord account associated with your Apple ID. Check the User Settings > Billing tab within the Discord account you originally made purchases on.   

Q: I purchased Nitro Basic and now I want to upgrade to Nitro or add additional Server Boosts to my Server Boost subscription purchased through the Apple App Store. How can I do this?

A: To upgrade your subscription from Nitro Basic to Nitro, you'll need to manage it through your Apple device. Follow these steps:

1. Open your Settings.

2. Select Apple ID.

3. Go to Subscriptions.

4. Tap on the active subscription.

5. Select “See all Plan Types” and select the subscription you wish to have. 

If you encounter any issues with your subscription or the upgrade process, please contact Apple Support for further assistance.

Q: I’m trying to make a Discord purchase through my Apple device and it’s not working. What should I do?

A: If you're experiencing issues while attempting to make a Discord purchase on your Apple device, we recommend trying to complete the purchase on the Desktop or Web client instead. If using a different device is not an option, the problem might be related to the Apple App Store. In this case, please contact Apple Support for further assistance.

name: How to Screen Share on MacOS
title: How to Screen Share on MacOS
body:
What this article covers:
  • What is Screen Sharing?
  • How to Screen Share on MacOS

What is Screen Sharing?

Note: To learn more about screen sharing, please check out the Go Live and Screen Share Help Center article. If you’d rather use a Stage Channel for screen sharing, please check out the Stage Channels FAQ Help Center article.

Screen Sharing allows you to share your screen or an application window through a voice call in a server, direct message, or group message. 

Note: When you’re in a voice call, any number of users can screen share, but only 50 users can watch an individual screen share.

How to Screen Share on MacOS

Note: Depending on the OS of your Mac device, your UI may look slightly different.

1. Join a voice channel that you have permissions to screen share in and then tap the Screen Share [] icon.

2. You can choose to share one of the following: Share entire screen, share a window, share an app, or you can tap on Or share a device to share from a device.

3. After deciding what you want to screen share, you can then select the Stream Quality, Resolution, and Frame Rate. After you’re finished with your selections, tap on Next.

4. You’ll be prompted by your MacOS device to select exactly what you want to screenshare. Tap Make Selection and then press on what you want to share to select it.

5. Now you’re screen sharing to the Discord app on a MacOS device!

name: Message Bookmarks and Reminders
title: Message Bookmarks and Reminders
body:
NOTE: This feature is currently experimental and available to a limited number of Nitro members.

What this article covers: 

  • What are Bookmarks? 
  • Bookmark a Message
    • Desktop/Browser
    • Mobile
  • Creating a Reminder
    • Desktop/Browser
    • Mobile

What are Bookmarks?

Discord's bookmarks feature is here to transform how you manage your conversations via chat, direct messages (DM), and group chats. Available exclusively for Nitro users, this tool allows you to:

  • Easily save important messages for later reference
  • Organize your Discord content more efficiently
  • Manage your saved items in real-time, with the ability to save or unsave messages as needed
NOTE: Bookmarks have a storage limit of 200 messages.

Never miss crucial information again! With bookmarks, you can keep track of important conversations and come back to them whenever you need.

Bookmark a Message

NOTE: As this feature is experimental, the steps may vary slightly. 

Bookmarking messages allows you to bookmark important information for easy access later. Whether you're using Discord on desktop, browser, or mobile, here's how you can bookmark messages:

Desktop/Browser

1. On desktop or browser, navigate to the message you would like to save. 

2. Right-click the message and select the Bookmark Message option in the dropdown menu, then press Bookmark. 

3. Once bookmarked, you will see a notification badge letting you know that the message has been saved for later. 

4. To view your bookmarked messages, press the Inbox icon [] in the upper-right corner of the app and select the Bookmarks tab to find your messages. 

On desktop/browser: To convert a bookmarked message into a reminder or unsave it, press the Inbox icon [] > Bookmarks tab. Then select the desired option in the upper right-corner of the bookmarked message.

Mobile

1. On mobile, navigate to the message you would like to save. 

2. Long-press the message and tap Bookmark Message in the menu. 

3. Once bookmarked, you will see a notification badge letting you know that the message has been saved for later. 

 

4. To view your bookmarked messages, tap Notifications [] located in the bottom hub and select the Bookmarks icon [] in the upper-right corner of the app. This will take you to the Bookmarks tab.    

 

 

On mobile: To convert a bookmarked message into a reminder or unsave it, navigate to Notifications [] > Bookmarks[]. Then tap the ellipsis [] in the upper-right corner of the message and select the desired option.  

Creating a Reminder

Reminders allow you to set notifications for important messages at a specific time.Here's how to create reminders on both desktop, browser, and mobile:

Desktop/Browser

1. On desktop or browser, select the Inbox icon [] in the upper-right corner of the app.

2. Hover over the message you would like to set as a reminder and press the Create Reminder icon [] in the upper-right corner of the message.

3. In the Remind Me menu, you can choose how long you’d like to wait before being reminded. 

Choosing the Custom option in the Remind Me menu allows you to set a specific date and time for your reminder.

4. To view your reminders, press the Inbox icon [] in the upper-right corner of the app and select the Bookmarks tab. Here, you’ll find your added reminders. Each reminder will display your chosen Due in timeframe above the message. 

On desktop/browser: To edit, complete, or remove the reminder, right-click the message you have set as a reminder within Inbox > Bookmarks. From there, choose your desired action. 

Mobile 

1. On mobile, navigate to the message you would like to set as a reminder. 

2. Long-press the message and tap Create Reminder in the menu. 

3. Choose when you would like to be reminded in the Remind Me… menu. 

 

4. Once set, you will see a notification badge letting you know that the message has been set as a reminder. 

5. To view your reminders, tap Notifications [] located in the bottom hub and select the Bookmarks icon [] in the upper-right corner of the app.  

   

On mobile: To edit or remove the reminder, tap the ellipsis [] in the upper-right corner of the reminder, then select the desired option. Tap the checkmark icon [] to mark it as complete.

name: Nitro Credits FAQ
title: Nitro Credits FAQ
body:
Nitro credits are an experimental reward that Discord users can earn for completing Quests that give you Nitro for a limited amount of time.

What this article covers:
  • What are Nitro Credits?
  • How do I earn Nitro Credits?
  • Where can I view my Nitro Credits?
  • How do I use Nitro Credits?
  • Managing Your Subscription with Active Nitro Credits
    • Nitro Subscription
    • Server Boost Subscription
  • Frequently Asked Questions
Info: Nitro credits are currently an experimental offer available to a limited number of users and only through the Discord desktop app.

What are Nitro Credits?

Nitro credits give you Nitro for a limited amount of time. 

  • They are earned by purchasing in the Shop, or by completing specific Quests. 
  • The duration of each credit varies depending on the Quest. 
  • Nitro credits do not expire and can stack if multiple Nitro credits are earned.
  • Nitro credits do not become a recurring subscription.
  • Once all your Nitro credits have been used and their duration is over, your Nitro subscription will revert to its normal state.
  • Some Nitro Perks are not available with Nitro credits. Perks that are not included:
    • Two Boosts
    • Boost discount
    • Profile badge
    • Share Nitro (Referral Program)
Info: Nitro credits do not give you 2 free Server Boosts or the 30% discount on additional Boost purchases. However, you can still enjoy all the other Nitro perks. To learn more about all Nitro perks, check out this article.

How do I earn Nitro Credits?

To earn Nitro credits, complete a specific Quest that offers them. Here's how:

1. Select the Discover icon [] at the bottom of the server list on the left side of the app. This takes you to the Discover page.

2. Select the Quest tab within the Discover list to explore available Discord Quests. You've now reached Quest Home, where you can find Quests offering Nitro credits.

Want to learn more?

For more details on accepting and completing Quests, check out our Discord Quests FAQ.

3. After completing the Quest, you'll receive a notification informing you that you've earned Nitro credits!

Confirmation of earned Nitro credits

Info: You can also get Nitro credits by spending Discord Orbs in the Shop > Orbs Exclusives. Discord Orbs is currently in Beta.

Where can I view my Nitro Credits?

To view your Nitro credits, go to your User Settings by selecting the cogwheel [] icon in the bottom-left corner of the app. 

Cogwheel icon on desktop

Then, press Subscriptions. In the Nitro Credit section, you can see how many credits you've earned, check their expiration date, and verify if your credits are active.

Example of Nitro credits displayed in Subscriptions tab

How do I use Nitro Credits? 

Once they are earned, Nitro credits activate automatically at different times depending on whether you have a pre-existing subscription or not. 

  • No Nitro subscription: credits activate instantly upon earning them.
  • Active Nitro subscription: credits activate automatically at the end of your current billing cycle. 

Managing Your Subscription with Active Nitro Credits

Nitro Subscription

If you have active Nitro credits and a Nitro subscription here’s what happens in different scenarios:

  • Starting a new Nitro subscription or upgrading: Your credits will pause and start again at the end of your billing cycle.
  • Downgrading or removing additional Boosts from Nitro: Any changes will take effect after your current credits expire.
  • Cancelling Nitro: Changes happen right away, but don't worry - your active credits will still work.

Server Boost Subscription

If you have a Boost-only subscription:

  • If you have a Boost-only subscription, you can freely manage your Boosts, including cancelling, without any impact to your Nitro credits.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What happens to my Nitro subscription if I earn Nitro credits?

A: Your Nitro subscription will continue until the end of your current billing cycle. Then, your Nitro credits will activate automatically, lasting for the time you've earned. Once your Nitro credits have been fully used, your paid Nitro subscription will automatically renew again.

Q: I’m a current Nitro subscriber. What happens to my billing date if I earn Nitro credits?

A: Your billing date will be adjusted to reflect any additional time earned through Nitro credits. 

Q: I have active Server Boosts with my current Nitro subscription. What happens to these Boosts if I activate my Nitro credits?

A: Your existing Server Boosts will remain active and unchanged. While Nitro credits are active, you’ll be able to transfer your Boosts between servers as long as it follows the normal cooldown periods. See our Boost FAQ for more information.  

Q: Can I purchase new Server Boosts when Nitro credits are active?

A: No, you won’t be able to purchase new Server Boosts when Nitro credits are active. 

Q: Can I cancel any Server Boost subscriptions I have while Nitro credits are active?

A: No, you won’t be able to cancel any pre-existing Boost subscriptions until your Nitro credits have been completely used. 

Q: What if I earn Nitro credits when my subscription is past due?

A: If you're rewarded Nitro credits while your subscription is past due, they will be applied in one of two ways:

  • If no successful payment is made during the 30-day grace period, the credits will be applied after the grace period ends.
  • If a payment is successful, the credits will be applied at your next billing cycle. 

Q: Can I use my earned Nitro credits at any time?

A: Nitro credits activate between billing cycles. They will automatically apply once your current subscription period ends. If you don’t have an active Nitro subscription, your Nitro credits will be activated immediately upon earning them.

Q: How do Nitro credits interact with subscription credits (gifts)?

A: The interaction between Nitro credits and subscription credits depends on your specific situation. Here are some common scenarios:

1. Active gift credit, no stored credits: Nitro credits activate after current gift period ends.

2. Multiple stored gift credits with an active subscription: Nitro credits activate after the current billing period. Then, the next gift credit will be used to continue the subscription.

3. Stored gift credits, no active subscription: Nitro credits activate immediately. Doesn't affect existing gift credits.

name: Using an Authenticator App on Discord
title: Using an Authenticator App on Discord
body:
What this article covers:
  • What is an Authenticator App?
  • How to Register an Authenticator App 
    • Mobile
    • Desktop/Browser
  • Logging in With an Authenticator App

What is an Authenticator App?

Using an Authenticator App (also called a Time-based One-Time Password or TOTP) is another great way to secure your account by providing a one-time code alongside your password - this ensures that someone can’t log into your account if they only have your password. You can set up an Authenticator App from your Account Settings on the mobile, desktop, and browser app.

How to Register an Authenticator App 

Mobile

1. Tap your avatar in the bottom-right corner and then tap on the cogwheel [] in the top-right corner.

2. Press on Account and then select Enable Authenticator App.

3. To begin this authentication process, you'll need to download either Google Authenticator or Authy on your mobile device.

4. Follow the instructions in the Discord app to copy your secret key into your Authenticator App so it can generate your one-time codes. You’ll be asked to enter one of those codes generated by the Authenticator App to ensure it’s working properly.

5. You can now link your phone number to your Discord account to help act as a backup method for obtaining these authentication codes. This can help you be less worried about losing access to your Authenticator app, but reduces how secure your account is.

6. After enabling an Authenticator App, the Discord app will also have a list of backup codes for login: each of these can be used once instead of a code generated by your Authenticator App, in case you lose access to it. Make sure to download and store these backup codes in a safe, easily accessible place! If you lose these, Discord can’t help you get back into your account.

If you set up your Authenticator App through Authy you can set up a backup by following these steps. If you set it up through Google Authenticator you can back up your account by following these steps.

Desktop/Browser

1. Start by selecting the the cogwheel [] next to your username.

2. This will open your User Settings and take you to the My Account page. While here, you will be able to view the Multi-Factor Authentication options under the Password and Authentication section.

3. Press the Enable Authenticator App button to get started. To begin the authenticator process, you will have to download Google Authenticator app or the Authy app on your mobile device. After you’ve downloaded an Authenticator App, open it on your mobile device and use the camera function to scan the QR code in the Discord app.

4. After scanning the QR code that is displayed in the Discord app, your Authenticator App will generate a 6 digit code. Enter that 6 digit code into “Login with your code” and then tap on Activate.

5. You can now link your phone number to your account to help act as a backup method for obtaining these authentication codes. This can help you be less worried about losing access to your Authenticator App, but reduces how secure your account is.

6. After enabling an Authenticator App, the Discord app will also have a list of backup codes for login: each of these can be used once instead of a code generated by your app, in case you lose access to it. Make sure to download and store these backup codes in a safe, easily accessible place! If you lose these, Discord can’t help you get back into your account.

If you set up your Authenticator App through Authy, you can set up a backup by following these steps. If you set it up through Google Authenticator, you can back up your account by following these steps.

Logging in With an Authenticator App

After enabling an Authenticator App you’ll see an additional prompt to enter an authentication code when you log in to your Discord:

Enter a code from your app or from your list of backup codes, select Confirm, and you’re in!

name: Requesting a Transfer of Server Ownership
title: Requesting a Transfer of Server Ownership
body:
When a server owner steps away or becomes inactive on Discord, this can leave their server without someone to look after it! When this happens, a server member can request ownership transfer to help take care of the server and keep things running smoothly for everyone! If you’d like to request ownership of a server, keep reading to learn how.

If you’re a server owner and you’d like to transfer ownership of your server, please reference our article on how to transfer server ownership!

What this article covers:

  • What is the policy for Server Ownership Transfers?
  • How do I submit a Server Ownership Transfer Request ticket?
    • What information is needed in a Server Ownership Transfer request?
    • How do I find a Server/User ID?
  • What if my Server is Partnered or Verified?
  • What if I Want to Request an Ownership Transfer of Multiple Servers?
  • Will the Inactive Server Owner be Notified of the Server Transfer?
  • A Note on Data and Your Privacy

What is the policy for Server Ownership Transfers?

The criteria for a server ownership transfer:

  • The server has 100 members.
  • The current server owner hasn't accessed their account for at least a month.
  • You (the requestor) have been active on your account in the last 30 days.
  • You (the requestor) have administrator or moderator permissions within the server.
  • The server is not monetized.
Our Support team can only assist with server ownership transfers if your request meets the criteria. If your request does not meet the criteria, then it will be denied— no exceptions.
Please note that we cannot transfer ownership if you’re asking on behalf of another user, and you will need to ask that other user to directly contact our Support team with their own transfer request! The new owner should be the one submitting the support ticket, unless your server is Partnered or Verified

How do I submit a Server Ownership Transfer Request ticket?

1. Visit us at https://support.discord.com/hc/requests/new

2. Under What Can We Help You With?, select Help & Support

3. Input the email associated with your Discord account

4. Under Type of Question?, select Server Related Requests

5. Under Server Related Requests, select Server Ownership Transfer Request

6. Input the requested information

When submitting your request, please indicate whether your server is monetized, partnered, or verified by selecting Yes/No in the appropriate fields.

What information is needed in a Server Ownership Transfer request?

In order for our support team to review your request, we will need you to submit the following information. Without the information below, we will be unable to proceed further with reviewing this request. If invalid information is provided, your request may be delayed and follow-up will be required.

  • Server Name
  • Server ID
  • Inactive owner's Discord Username
  • Inactive owner's User ID
  • New owner's Discord Username
  • New owner's User ID

How do I find a Server/User ID?

To find the Server/User ID you will need to enable Developer Mode on your Discord app.

You can check out this support article on how you can enable developer mode.

User ID: right-click a user’s avatar and then select Copy User ID. You can also press on a user’s avatar > press on the ellipses icon in the top right corner of the user’s profile > select Copy User ID.

Server ID: right-click the server’s name or the server icon and then select Copy Server ID.

What if my Server is Partnered or Verified?

Before submitting a ticket, please check if your server is Partnered or Verified. If your server is Partnered or Verified, you will have the corresponding badge next to your server’s name. You can learn more about server types on this support article.

If you own a Partnered or Verified server and wish to transfer ownership, you must submit the request yourself.

Please note that if your server has the Community Feature enabled, this does not mean that your server is Partner or Verified.

When submitting your transfer request, please only select Yes under Is your server Partnered, Verified? If your server is confirmed to be Partnered or Verified, not Community. Choosing incorrectly could delay your request processing.

What if I Want to Request an Ownership Transfer of Multiple Servers?

Our team can only handle one server per request. Therefore, if you want to request ownership of multiple servers, we ask that you file a separate ticket for each one.

Will the Inactive Server Owner be Notified of the Server Transfer?

If a server owner is inactive and not banned, then we do contact them to get their consent for the server ownership transfer. The current server owner has 7 days to respond to our inquiry. If they approve the transfer or they don’t respond within 7 days, we transfer the server if eligible per our requirements. If the current owner denies the transfer request or the criteria for transfer is not met, we will not be able to proceed with the transfer of the server.

A Note on Data and Your Privacy

In line with data minimization principles, information provided by you in your server ownership transfer request will be deleted after the transfer is complete.

We take your privacy and data security seriously. The information collected during the server ownership transfer process, including the server name, server ID, inactive owner's Discord username and user ID, and the new owner's Discord username and user ID, will be used solely for processing your transfer request. This data will be handled confidentially and in accordance with Discord’s Privacy Policy and applicable data protection laws.

name: 3 Months Discord Nitro for YouTube Premium Users Promo FAQ
title: 3 Months Discord Nitro for YouTube Premium Users Promo FAQ
body:
Starting from October 7, 2024 (10:00AM PT) to June 30, 2025 (11:59PM PT), eligible YouTube Premium subscribers within the United States can claim a 3 month trial of Discord Nitro through YouTube's Member Hub. 

During this same period, eligible YouTube Premium subscribers in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, France, Germany, Japan, and South Korea can claim their 3-month Discord Nitro offer via email. Learn below about how you can claim Discord Nitro.

Promotion Summary

Offer Details: 3 months of Discord Nitro for eligible YouTube Premium subscribers

Who is Eligible: To claim through YouTube Premium, you must be a current YouTube Premium subscriber in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, France, Germany, Japan, and South Korea. 

  • If you currently have a free YouTube Premium subscription, you will not be eligible to claim this promotion.

To redeem in Discord, you must redeem on the Discord desktop or browser app.

Users who have never had an active Nitro subscription on their Discord accounts are eligible to redeem this Nitro promotion. Eligible Nitro Basic or Classic subscribers who have not had an active Nitro Basic or Classic subscription in the 12 months prior to redeeming this promotion are eligible.  

If a user has a Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting subscription active on their account, redeeming this promotion will override that subscription. We will not be able to refund any leftover subscription time from those, and the user will be forfeiting the remainder of the existing sub when activating the 3 month Nitro trial.

Requirements:

Redeem to Discord account by July 29, 2025 (11:59PM PT).

Subscription:

After the 3 month free trial period, your Nitro subscription will convert to a monthly recurring subscription, and Discord will bill your payment method per month until you cancel it. You can cancel at any time in your Discord User Settings.

What this article covers: 

  • What is YouTube Premium? 
  • What is Discord Nitro?
  • How do I claim the Nitro Promo from YouTube  
    • Eligibility for the Claiming this Promotion from YouTube
    • Step By Step Claim Instructions 
  • How do I redeem the Nitro Trial on my Discord Account? 
    • Eligibility for Redeeming the Nitro Trial
    • Step by Step Redeem Instructions
      • What if I am an Active Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting Subscriber? 
  • How do I share my Code with a Friend?
  • Frequently Asked Questions
    • Promotion Details
    • Eligibility for the Promotion
    • Payment Info and Subscription Questions
    • Potential Errors and Other Issues

What is YouTube Premium? 

YouTube Premium is a paid membership to help you elevate your experience on YouTube and other YouTube apps.

Everything you love about YouTube, ad-free and uninterrupted! Learn more here.

What is Discord Nitro?

With Nitro, you’ll get many awesome chat perks to enhance your Discord experience! Upgrade your emoji, enjoy bigger file uploads, stand out in your favorite Discords, and more! Check out some of these perks below! 

  • Custom Profiles
  • Global Custom emojis
  • Higher Video quality
  • Server Boosting
  • More!

How do I claim the Discord Nitro Promo from YouTube

As long as you're a YouTube Premium member, you'll be able to claim the Nitro promo from YouTube from October 7, 2024 (10:00AM PT) to June 30, 2025 (11:59PM PT). 

Eligibility for the Claiming this Promotion from YouTube

In order to claim this promotion link, you'll need to be an active subscriber to YouTube Premium. You will also need to have opted-in to marketing emails from YouTube in order to be sent the code.

In the US, active YouTube Premium subscribers can claim the code from their YouTube Premium Member Hub. All offer claims must be by June 30, 2025 (11:59PM PT) and redeemed by July 29, 2025 (11:59PM PT).

NOTE: If you currently have a YouTube Premium trial subscription, you will not be eligible to claim this promotion.

Step By Step Claim Instructions 

Within Your Email

To claim your Discord Nitro 3-month trial within your email, you must:  

1. Be a current YouTube Premium subscriber that has opted-in to marketing emails from YouTube to receive this promotion.

2. Press “Get Discord Nitro” in the email sent from YouTube Premium to start the redemption process for your 3-month free trial of Discord Nitro.

Within your YouTube Premium Account (US only)

1. Visit YouTube and log in to your YouTube Premium account.

2. Press on your profile picture in the top right, and select “Your Premium Benefits” from the dropdown menu. This is where you can find all your YouTube Premium membership benefits including the Discord Nitro benefit.

3. Select the Discord Nitro benefit and from here the promo link and details will appear in a pop-up. Press the promo link and you will be automatically redirected to claim your free Nitro. You can also copy and paste the link into your browser. 

4. Select “Redeem Now” to be redirected to redeem your 3-month free trial of Discord Nitro.

How do I redeem the Nitro Trial on my Discord Account? 

Once you have claimed the Discord Nitro YouTube offer, you'll now need to officially redeem this promo link on your Discord account (or share this code with a friend)!

Eligibility for Redeeming the Nitro Trial

Users who have never had an active Nitro subscription on their Discord accounts are eligible to redeem this Nitro promotion.

Users who have had a Discord Nitro subscription at any point on their accounts and have had a Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic subscription in the past 12 months are ineligible to redeem this promotion.

If a user has had a Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting subscription active on their account and they’ve never had a Nitro subscription, redeeming this promotion will override that subscription.

Step by Step Redeem Instructions

If you're eligible and ready to redeem this Nitro subscription on your own Discord account, you can follow these steps below to redeem the promo!

NOTE:
- Before redeeming Nitro, make sure you are logged in your own Discord account.
- If you accidentally redeemed the Nitro promo link on an account that is not yours, we are unable to provide you with another promo link.

Step 1 - Pressing the Promo Link/Copy and Pasting into your Browser Window

  • Start by directly pressing on the promotion link within the YouTube Premium Member Hub or copy and paste the link into your browser window.

Note: If you enter this Nitro promo link from the YouTube premium promotion into the Discord Gift Inventory or as a link within Discord chat, you will see an error when attempting to redeem the promotion. This is the incorrect method of redeeming this promo.

Step 2 - Logging into Discord

  •  If you're not already logged into Discord in your browser, you will then be automatically redirected to either:

Register for a New Account

If you don't have an account, you can directly register a new Discord account

Login to your Account

If you already have a Discord account, you can login to your account using your email and password or using QR code login

Step 3 - Confirming the Correct Account and Payment Method

  • Once you have logged into your Discord account, you'll see a new message asking you to confirm that you are accepting the Nitro subscription on the correct Discord account.
    • You'll see a notice saying: "You are accepting this gift as _________" 
  • If your Discord account does not have your payment information, you'll be asked to fill out your payment details. (Note: You will not be charged until the free trial ends and the subscription renews)
  • When you've filled out all the necessary information and you're ready to redeem this promotion, press the "Accept Gift" button. 
NOTE:
- If you're logged into the incorrect Discord account, press the "Wrong account" button to login to the other account! 

Step 4 - Subscription Now Activated

  • After accepting the promo to your account, you'll now be automatically redirected to your Subscriptions tab in your User Settings to see your newly activated Nitro subscription on your account.

What if I am an Active Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting Subscriber? 

Just to clarify - if you have had a Discord Nitro subscription at any point on your account and have had a Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic subscription in the past 12 months, you are ineligible to redeem this promotion.

So long as you have had a Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting subscription active on your account and you’ve never had a Nitro subscription, you will be able to redeem this promotion and replace it with the 3 month Nitro subscription.

HOWEVER, please note:
- By choosing to activate this 3 month trial, you will lose any features associated with your current subscriptions, and **you will not receive a refund for any remaining value on your current subscription**.

At the end of the promotion period, you'll be converted to a paying Nitro subscription per month unless you cancel your subscription.

How do I share my Code with a Friend?

If you've had a Nitro subscription previously on your Discord account in the past 12 months and you're unable to redeem the Nitro subscription link, you can share this link with a friend to use instead.

After you locate the Discord Nitro benefit in the YouTube Premium Member Hub, you can copy the promotion link and send it to a friend. We recommend sending the link in a private direct message.

Frequently Asked Questions

We know there's a lot of information to unpack on this promotion above, so we've also broken down this information in this FAQ section as well! 

  • Promotion Details
  • Eligibility for the Promotion
  • Payment Info and Subscription Questions
  • Potential Errors and Other Issues
    • Already Had/Have Nitro
    • Already Redeemed
    • Something's Wrong Here

Promotion Details

Q: How long does this promotion run for?

A: YouTube Premium subscribers within the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, France, Germany, Japan, and South Korea can claim Discord Nitro promo between October 7, 2024 (10:00AM PT) - June 30, 2025 (11:59PM PT). 

Q: How long does the Discord Nitro promotion link last for?

A: You must redeem the Nitro promotion by July 29, 2025 (11:59PM PT) if you’re a YouTube Premium subscriber.

If a code has not been redeemed to the Discord account by July 29, 2025 (11:59pm PT), it will expire and you will no longer be able to claim 3 months of Discord Nitro. 

Eligibility for the Promotion

Q: Who will receive this offer from YouTube Premium via email?

A:  In order to receive this offer from YouTube via email, you need to 1) be a current YouTube Premium subscriber in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, France, Germany, Japan, and South Korea and 2) have opted-in to receive YouTube marketing emails.

  • If you run into any issues, please reach out to YouTube Premium support via the form at the bottom of this help article: https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/13365794
  • Note: If you currently have a free YouTube Premium subscription, you will not be eligible to claim this promotion. 

Q: Who can claim this promotion from their YouTube Premium Member Hub?

A: In order to see this offer from YouTube in the YouTube Premium Member Hub, you must be a current YouTube Premium subscriber in the United States, where this functionality is active.

  • Note: If you currently have a free YouTube Premium subscription, you will not be eligible to claim this promotion. 

Q: Who can redeem this Nitro trial to their Discord account?

A: Users who have never had an active Nitro subscription on their Discord accounts are eligible to redeem this Nitro promotion.

Additionally, users who previously had a Discord Nitro subscription and have had a Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic subscription in the past 12 months are ineligible.

Q: What if I'm a current or previous Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or a Server Boost subscriber? Can I also take part in this promotion? 

A: If you previously had a Discord Nitro subscription at any point on your accounts and have had a Nitro Classic or Nitro Basic subscription in the past 12 months, you are ineligible to redeem this promotion.

If you have had a Nitro Basic, Nitro Classic, or Server Boosting subscription active on your account and you’ve never had a Nitro subscription, you will be able to redeem this promotion and replace it with the 3 months Nitro subscription.

HOWEVER, please note:
- By choosing to activate this 3 month trial, you will lose any features associated with your current subscriptions, and **you will not receive a refund for any remaining value on your current subscription**.

At the end of the promotion period, you'll be converted to a paying Nitro subscription per month unless you cancel your subscription.

Payment Info and Subscription Questions

Q: Why do I need to submit my payment info to redeem Nitro?
